title: Lead Fullstack Engineer - CDI Paris - Theodo AI-Modernisation
description:
L’histoire du groupe Theodo et son succès 

Theodo accompagne depuis 2009 les entreprises innovantes dans la conception, le développement et le déploiement de produits digitaux ingénieux - tels que la plateforme TF1+, l'application LCL Pro ou l'application France Identité Numérique - en tirant parti du meilleur de la technologie et de l’approche Lean. 

Theodo connait une croissance exceptionnelle depuis 15 ans : nos équipes rassemblent plus de 750 Theodoers, principalement des Software Engineers, passionnés de technologie et d’amélioration continue. En 2025, le groupe Theodo génère 100M€ de CA. 

Aujourd’hui, l’ambition du groupe est de se positionner comme le leader de l’IA appliquée au développement logiciel, c’est pourquoi nous avons lancé la practice AI Modernisation. Au sein de cette practice, nous accompagnons nos clients dans la modernisation de leurs systèmes legacy. Grâce à une IA maîtrisée et une méthode éprouvée, nous allons 3 fois plus vite sur le delivery de ces projets critiques. 

La practice accompagne principalement des scale-ups comme Qonto ou Doctolib et des grands groupes comme Carrefour, Pernod Ricard, Les Mousquetaires, Urgo, Cdiscount ou Edenred. 

Si tu veux rejoindre le futur de la tech, tu es au bon endroit ! 

Ton équipe : 

Tu rejoindras une communauté tech de plus de 350 Theodoers : software engineers, tech leads, engineering managers et architectes, avec lesquels tu pourras échanger, apprendre et progresser au quotidien.

Chez Theodo, les techs travaillent en équipes projet, constituées en fonction des besoins de chaque client. Tu feras partie d’une équipe de Theodoers à taille humaine (4 à 5 personnes), réunissant Software Engineers, Tech Lead et Product Manager. Ensemble, vous collaborerez étroitement avec le client, avec des échanges réguliers pour partager vos avancées, approfondir la compréhension de son problème et faire évoluer le produit au plus près des besoins de ses utilisateurs.

Les métiers du Software Engineering évoluent avec l’IA : viens apprendre à devenir un Tech Lead AI Native.

Tes futures missions : 

Nous recrutons un·e Tech Lead pour concevoir et développer des produits digitaux utiles, performants et durables pour répondre aux problématiques de nos clients et de leurs utilisateurs.

En tant que Tech Lead, tu es garant du rythme et de la qualité de delivery de ton projet. Tu mobilises ton équipe, fais les choix techniques adaptés au contexte et accompagnes les Software Engineers dans leur progression, avec l’objectif de faire grandir à la fois le produit et les personnes qui le construisent.

- Garantir le delivery et la qualité du projet 

Tu vises un niveau de qualité radicalement supérieur, en structurant le delivery autour de standards :

- 

- Concevoir des architectures évolutives et résilientes (diagrammes d’architecture clairs et partagés)

- Rédiger des spécifications précises pour permettre le développement sans bugs de fonctionnalités

- Mettre en place une stratégie de qualité basée sur : le Clean Code, les tests automatisés, les code reviews

- Assurer un environnement de travail structuré avec les principes 5S (organisation, clarté, efficacité)

- Accélérer la vitesse de développement grâce au déploiement des agents IA

- Être le partenaire technique du client 

- Participer aux routines projet (backlog refinement, daily, cérémonies) et veiller à la satisfaction continue du client

- Expliquer et défendre les choix techniques pour créer de la confiance et aligner toutes les parties prenantes

- Créer les conditions de performance de l’équipe 

- 

- Mettre en place un environnement de travail efficace et structuré pour l’équipe projet

- Mettre en place des boucles de résolution des problèmes via le Daily Problem Solving

- Créer les conditions pour que l’équipe exploite les LLM et gagne en productivité dans son quotidien

- Faire progresser les Software Engineers de ton équipe 

- 

- Analyser de manière appronfondie les défauts à la source dans le but d’améliorer les connaissance des équipes (Dantotsu)

- Former et accompagner l’équipe (pair programming, code reviews, formation)

Les problématiques sont très différentes d’un projet à l’autre, voici quelques exemples : 

- HealthHero : leader européen de la télémédecine, ils souhaitent moderniser leur plateforme française, Qare, en vue d’une fusion avec la plateforme UK. L’objectif est de passer de Loopback2 à Nest pour pouvoir upgrade de Node 10 vers Node 20. Grâce à notre méthode de modernisation accélérée par l’IA, nous passons d’une estimation à 70 semaines sans IA à une migration terminée en 21 semaines et accélérons la vitesse de delivery par 5.

- Pernod Ricard : souhaitait moderniser une application interne utilisée pour gérer leur campagnes marketing, des millions d’euros en jeu. L’impact de Theodo : 23 semaines pour moderniser complètement l’application de Vue Express vers React Nest avec une réécriture plus pragmatique. Nous avons également effectué la connection à leur nouvel ERP, auparavant impossible sans la migration.

Tes perspectives d’évolution : 

2 axes d’évolutions s’offrent à toi:

- Architecte senior : développer une expertise technique

- Solution Architect: participer à le vente de projets complexes en définissant les solutions techniques les plus ingénieuses pour nous permettre de gagner

- Managériale : Engineering Manager

Une méthodologie basée sur l’apprentissage continu :

Chez Theodo, nous avons construit notre approche tech autour d’une conviction forte : on développe d’abord les personnes, avant de développer les produits .

Notre Lean Tech® System met l’accent sur l’apprentissage continu : tu évolueras dans un environnement qui investit sur le long terme, où l’objectif est de te permettre de progresser chaque jour, tout en construisant des produits utiles et performants pour nos clients.

Profil recherché : 

- 4 à 8 ans d’expérience en développement

- Solide maîtrise des architectures web (front, back, BDD, infra, déploiement) et des pratiques DevOps (Docker, Kubernetes).

- Capacité à concevoir des architectures scalables , faire des choix techniques pertinents et garantir un haut niveau de qualité de code .

- Expérience dans le coaching et l’accompagnement de développeurs, en restant connecté·e à la tech (veille, code, pair programming).

- Orientation création de valeur et compréhension des enjeux métier du client.

Pourquoi rejoindre Theodo ? 

L’environnement: 

💼 Rejoindre un groupe de 750 personnes avec de nombreuses possibilités d’évolutions cross-entités 

🤝 Chaque Theodoer est accompagné par un coach interne. Son objectif : t’épauler dans ton quotidien et parler objectifs de carrière via des séances de coaching hebdomadaires. 

🎯 Participation à des projets associatifs grâce à la Fondation Theodo (Ada Tech School, Code Phoenix, Article 1…) 

🎉 Soirées mensuelles, keynotes et week-end d’entreprise annuel 

Le package : 

📈 Actionnariat salarié pour être associé à la réussite du groupe 

💸 De l’épargne salariale avec un mécanisme d’ intéressement en partenariat avec Epsor 

🖥 Budget équipement (ordinateur, smartphone, écouteurs…) 

🧒 Des avantages fournis par notre CSE (sport avec Gymlib,...) 

🏖 5 semaines + 8 à 12 RTT/an 

🩺 Mutuelle (SideCare) prise en charge à 50% 

🍽 Carte ticket-restaurants Swile 

🧒 Aides et places en crèche réservées

title: Technical Account Manager - Benelux
description:
Camunda is the enterprise platform for agentic orchestration , enabling organizations to coordinate AI agents, people, and systems across complex, end-to-end business processes. With built-in governance, auditability, and human oversight, Camunda gives enterprises the control they need to move AI from pilots to production — safely and at scale. Trusted by over 700 organizations worldwide , including 9 of top 10 US banks, Camunda helps enterprises boost operational efficiency, accelerate time-to-value, and deliver better customer experiences.

Fully remote and global, we are in the middle of something bigger: transforming into an AI-first organisation, built on our own platform . We use Agentic AI to automate, orchestrate intelligent processes, and elevate human contribution across every team.

Named GP Bullhound’s Top 100 Next Unicorn list, 2025 Great Place to Work certified. Visionary in 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Business Orchestration and Automation Technologies. ranked 3rd in Flexa's 2026 Most Flexible Companies , We’re growing fast and looking for top talent to join our team. If you want meaningful work, visible impact and put something genuinely rare on your CV, keep reading. 

About the role: 

At Camunda, our Technical Account Managers (TAMs) are trusted technical advisors, partnering closely with our most strategic customers to help them turn their process orchestration vision into measurable business value. In this highly impactful role, you’ll be “in the boat together” with clients from day one – navigating technical challenges, providing expert guidance, and ensuring smooth adoption of our platform at scale. Success means building lasting relationships, accelerating customer outcomes, and making complex technology feel approachable for diverse teams. If you thrive on collaboration, love solving unique challenges, and are excited to empower companies across industries, we want you on our fast-growing, innovative Customer Success team.

What You Will Do 

- Serve as the primary technical contact and trusted advisor for designated enterprise customers, leading them through all stages of their Camunda adoption journey

- Guide the creation and execution of tailored technical adoption plans, designed to maximize business outcomes and ensure long-term success

- Deliver hands-on technical guidance, best practices, and advisory services to both business and technical stakeholders – from onboarding through ongoing operations

- Identify and remove execution risks by proactively conducting platform and solution health checks, facilitating escalation management, and advocating for customer needs internally

- Foster strong, collaborative relationships with cross-functional Camunda teams such as Customer Success Managers, Consulting, Support, Product, Engineering, Sales and Pre-Sales to drive measurable customer outcomes at scale

- Regularly spend time on-site with accounts for key milestone interactions (as needed, up to 50% during busy periods) to deepen partnerships and accelerate strategic initiatives

What You Will Bring to the Role 

- At least 3 years of experience as a Technical Account Manager or a directly comparable role in enterprise software

- Demonstrated technical expertise: hands-on with a high-level programming language (such as Java, C#, or Python) and relevant enterprise software frameworks

- Solid understanding of modern solution architectures and associated paradigms, including DevOps topics (especially Kubernetes)

- A proven track record of building trusted relationships and providing advisory services to both technical and business stakeholders—able to synthesize and explain complex

- issues clearly to varied audiences

- Strategic problem solving competencies with a collaborative, impact-driven mindset; comfortable tailoring approaches to unique customer situations

- Willingness and flexibility to spend time on-site with clients as account needs dictate (up to 50% during busy periods)

Nice to Haves: 

- Experience in enterprise automation, business process management, process orchestration, or robotic process automation

- Relevant industry certifications (AWS Certified Solutions Architect, Azure Solutions Architect Expert, CKAD, CKA, etc.)

- Familiarity with Camunda products

- Ability and/or willingness to use our product .

Nice-to-haves: 

- Experience in enterprise automation, business process management, process orchestration, or robotic process automation

- Relevant industry certifications (AWS Certified Solutions Architect, Azure Solutions Architect Expert, CKAD, CKA, etc.)

- Familiarity with Camunda products

This role is an existing vacancy 

#LI-AL1 #LI-Remote 

What We Have to Offer: 

Compensation 

We offer competitive, fair, and transparent compensation. Salary ranges are location-based, with Standard and Major markets (global tech hubs) reflecting local competition.

The Annual Total Target Cash (base salary + 100% variable target, where applicable) shown below spans from the minimum in a Standard market to the maximum in a Major market. Final offers depend on skills , experience , and location , and we typically hire in the first half of the range to allow room for growth:

- United States: $150,100.00 to $242,000.00 

- United Kingdom: £94,200.00 to £155,000.00 

- Singapore: S$186,400.00 to S$279,600.00

If you’re based elsewhere, you’ll be hired via Remote.com (our global employer partner), and your Talent Acquisition Partner will provide a personalized Total Rewards Calculator after your first interview.

Equity: We also offer equity (where applicable) through our Virtual Stock Option Plan (VSOP) .

Benefits & Perks 

We invest in your wellbeing, growth, and ability to connect, along with perks that support you no matter where you’re based. Our benefits are globally designed and locally delivered where applicable.

title: Senior Specialist, Market Planning
description:
About Wolt 

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we're building the delivery of (almost) everything and you'll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn't always easy, but it's definitely exciting. Here you'll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You'll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you're a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life. 

At Wolt, keeping courier supply healthy across every city we operate in is core to a great experience for both customers and couriers. As we've scaled to dozens of countries and hundreds of cities, planning & managing supply has grown from a market-by-market exercise into a global challenge: we need a system that plans well everywhere at once, from our largest metros to our smallest cities.

That's where this role comes in. As Senior Specialist, Global Market Planning, you'll help refine the models and tools at the heart of how we plan courier supply globally. You'll make sure the right supply levers are pulled in the right markets, and you'll help us learn which levers actually work. It's a role at the crossroads of data, tooling, and operations. It's for someone who is as comfortable designing a test or building a model as they are working out why a specific market is off plan and what to do about it.

You'll be part of the Global Market Planning team and will partner closely with local operations and courier marketing so that our planning always reflects the reality on the ground.

What you'll be doing 

- Develop the global planning model: Help develop and refine our global supply planning model so it delivers robust coverage across both large and small cities, accounting for local context like holidays, special events, etc.

- Allocate investments across markets: Help optimize supply lever allocation, translating region and country budgets into the right mix of levers for each market.

- Test and learn in markets: Propose tests and actions within markets, in line with lever allocation, especially where we don't yet know the right answer or don't have enough data to rely on history. You'll work with local teams and analytics to shape the approach and turn what we learn into the next plan.

- Build the tooling: Develop tools that ensure the correct supply levers are being used effectively across markets to hit our targets.

- Deep dive & solve: Investigate problem areas, identify root causes, and turn your findings into corrective actions and better planning approaches.

- Collaborate: Partner with regional supply leads, local operations teams, and central teams (finance, procurement, product, analytics) on plans, performance, and improvements.

- Improve how we work: Test and prove new concepts in planning, acquisition, onboarding, and activation, and support the roll-out of global improvements across regions.

Our humble expectations 

- 3+ years of experience in consulting, operations, analytics, or strategic business development in a fast-paced environment.

- Strong analytical and modelling skills, with a structured, pragmatic approach to solving complex problems.

- Experience designing and interpreting tests or causal analyses, and good judgment about what you can and can't conclude from them in a marketplace setting.

- A systems view of supply: you consider trade-offs between levers and their knock-on effects on cost, courier experience, and customer experience.

- Comfort making and defending recommendations with incomplete data, and adapting your thinking when the facts change.

- Proficiency in SQL, Looker, and Excel/Google Sheets modelling. Python, Cursor, and Claude Code are a plus.

- An attitude for action and ownership beyond the obvious, always looking for opportunities to improve, with the determination to drive change.

- The ability to work across cross-functional teams and manage relationships with stakeholders, both local and global.

- A true culture champion who leads by example with collaboration, teamwork, and data-driven decision making, and who brings humility and respect to every interaction.

- Excellent written and oral communication skills in English.

- Based in Berlin or Helsinki, with the ability to work in a hybrid model from our Wolt office.

Next steps 

What to expect from our hiring process:

- Talent Acquisition screen — an introductory conversation with our recruiter to learn more about your background and answer any initial questions about the role.

- Hiring Manager interview — a deeper conversation with the team manager about your experience, the team, and what this role involves day to day.

- Assignment — a practical task related to the role, giving you a chance to show how you approach real problems in this space.

- Final interview — a conversation with a senior stakeholder to round out the process.

If you are excited about working in a high-growth environment, taking ownership and being part of an extremely ambitious team, then click below to apply and get the conversation going!

We will be reviewing applications on an ongoing basis, so if this sounds like an opportunity you want to pursue, apply today!

Please submit your up-to-date resume in English. 

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion 

We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

title: Senior Full Stack
description:
Headquarters: Tallinn, Estonia

URL: https://toggl.com/jobs/ 

We are looking for a Senior Full Stack Engineer to join one of our Product Tribes, the cross-functional units that own the end-to-end experience for a specific Toggl user role. You'll join the Tribe building for managers, the people who plan work, protect margins, and keep projects on time and on budget.

You own significant parts of that experience end-to-end, working hands-on with product and design to ship work that matters. You'll do this as we build and launch Toggl 2.0, our consolidated planning, time tracking, and time intelligence product.

The salary for this position is €83,000 annually. 

You can work from anywhere in the world as long as your main location is between UTC-4 and UTC+4. 

The Role 

As a Senior Full Stack Engineer, you own meaningful parts of the product end-to-end, from the data model and the API to the interface someone actually clicks: the technical approach, the quality of what ships, and whether it actually works for the people using it. You are accountable not for tickets closed, but for clarity, craft, and outcomes.

You'll work in the Tribe serving managers, across planning and capacity management, dashboards, and billable work. This is some of the most data-dense, interaction-heavy surface area in the product: schedules and capacity views, reports, and visualizations that have to stay fast and readable at real customer scale. The interesting problems live on both sides of the API here - the query behind a capacity view matters as much as how that view renders. You'll build with React and TypeScript on the frontend and our backend services (mostly Golang) and data layer (Postgres) behind them, alongside a product manager, a designer, and engineers who are used to owning their work and pushing back when something isn't right. In a tribe of 5 other engineers, your impact and visibility are high.

Our team meetings are scheduled between 11:00 and 16:00 UTC. Your availability and commitment to participate in these sessions are essential for effective collaboration and team alignment.

Your main responsibilities will be:

Ownership and delivery 

- 
Take projects from problem to production. Own the technical approach for major features front to back, break the work down sensibly, sequence it, and ship in slices rather than one big drop.

- 
Make the technical calls in your area. Choose between options, name the tradeoffs, and decide without waiting for permission or escalating routine judgment.

- 
Keep your work visible without being chased. Flag risks and slips early, keep the Tribe in the loop, and unblock yourself.

Craft and quality across the stack 

- 
Build interfaces people trust with dense, real-world data. Planning views, dashboards, and reports that stay fast, accessible, and readable when the dataset gets ugly.

- 
Design the data and API layer those views depend on. Model it so the feature you're building now doesn't make the next three harder.

- 
Own performance as a feature, end to end. Profile, measure, and fix the slow query and the slow render instead of hoping the data stays small.

- 
Write code others can work in. Sensible components and services, real test coverage where it earns its keep, and a codebase that's easier to change after you touch it.

Working with product and design 

- 
Shape solutions, don't just implement them. Push on the problem, question requirements that don't hold up, and propose simpler paths when you see one.

- 
Partner closely with design. Prototype early, spot the edge cases in a flow before it's built, and hold the bar on UX quality with your designer rather than after handoff.

- 
Stay close to users and evidence. Join user tests, read the feedback, look at the data, and let it change what you build.

Raising the bar 

- 
Review code with intent. Give precise, actionable feedback that makes the change and the person better.

- 
Mentor and interview. Help other engineers grow, and help us hire well.

- 
Improve things across team boundaries. Spot shared components and duplicated work between Tribes, and raise it before we build the same thing twice.

AI as core leverage 

- 
Use AI tools extensively in your daily work for exploration, prototyping, code generation and review, debugging, research, and writing. AI fluency is not optional. It's part of how you increase your speed, depth, and impact - and you're expected to help the rest of the Tribe get better at it too.

About You 

You will thrive in this role if you:

- 
Have significant experience building and shipping production web applications end to end, and can lead major projects rather than just contribute to them.

- 
Are genuinely comfortable on both sides of the stack. You're deep on one side and properly capable on the other, not someone who hands off at the API boundary.

- 
Have deep, practical knowledge of JavaScript, TypeScript, React, and modern CSS - including state management and side-effect handling in large applications.

- 
Are solid on backend fundamentals: at least one backend language you know well, API design, relational data modelling, and enough instinct for query performance to spot the problem before production does. Prior Golang experience is not mandatory but you have to be willing to adopt it and become comfortable with it fast. 

- 
Hold an extremely high bar for quality. You know what great looks like, you notice the details others miss, and you don't ship work you wouldn't put your name on.

- 
Have a knack for data-heavy product surfaces - performance, readability, and the principles behind a chart that actually communicates something.

- 
Care about the user's problem, not just the ticket. You start from what someone is trying to get done and work back to the implementation.

- 
Own outcomes, not output. You follow your work into production, watch how it behaves, and fix what needs fixing.

- 
Thrive in ambiguity and move fast. You make confident decisions with incomplete information, adapt when things change, and course-correct without drama.

- 
Are hands-on with AI tools. You actively use AI as a core part of how you build, not a side experiment, and you have opinions about where it helps and where it doesn't.

- 
Don't need to be managed. You set your own direction, keep people in the loop, and ask for help when it matters.

- 
Have excellent written and verbal English communication skills. You write clearly, explain technical tradeoffs to non-engineers without jargon, and default to async communication that others can follow.

- 
Are eager to contribute to the engineering team's growth - code review, mentoring, and interviewing included.

- 
Value transparency, ownership, and speed over perfection. You ship, learn, and improve rather than waiting for the perfect plan.

- 
Nice to have: 

- 
Experience with TanStack is a bonus, and so is a real understanding of frontend caching and eventual consistency, we'd love to hire someone who's dealt with that tradeoff directly.

- 
Experience with capacity planning, scheduling, reporting, or other complex B2B SaaS products.

- 
Experience working with distributed or microservice systems, a basic understanding of infrastructure and infrastructure as code, and some experience creating, improving, or debugging CI/CD pipelines.

This Role Is NOT 

- 
A ticket-taker role. If you want fully specced work handed to you, this isn't the right fit.

- 
A pixel-pusher translating finished designs into code with no say in the problem or the solution.

- 
A role where you hand off at the API boundary. If "that's a backend ticket" is your instinct, this will frustrate you.

- 
A role where quality is someone else's job. Toggl doesn't have a dedicated QA
team or layer: there's no separate team that will catch your bugs, write your
tests, or own your performance regressions.

- 
A place to work in isolation from users. You'll be expected to know who you're building for and why.

- 
A role for people who need heavy process, frequent approvals, or top-down direction to do their best work.

The Team 

We are a global team of ~80 awesome people working from over 40 countries around the globe. We hire globally, you work locally—in the heart of London, a beach outside of Río de Janeiro, or a quiet village near Florence, the choice is yours. Every few months we travel to meet up somewhere in the world and spend some quality time together. We place a huge amount of trust in our people, and we measure the outcomes rather than the work itself. Our values fuel our results.

What's Happening at Toggl 

Toggl is at an exciting turning point. We're taking our best-in-class time tracking - trusted and loved by millions of users worldwide - and expanding it into something bigger: Toggl 2.0 . One product that brings together time tracking, planning, capacity management, reporting, and insight. The idea is simple: better time tracking creates better data, which powers everything else. We call it time intelligence. We build with AI throughout, and we think it's a real multiplier for strong engineers rather than a substitute for them. The judgment, the tradeoffs, and the accountability for what ships stay with people.

Benefits 

- 
Freedom to choose when and how much you work—we only measure results

- 
24 days of paid time off a year, plus your local holidays

- 
Unlimited sick leave

- 
In-person meetups for team-building (expenses covered)

- 
4-6 weeks paid sabbatical (depending on tenure)

- 
Laptop budget up to 2,500€ and it renews every 3 years

- 
€2,000 budget to set up your home office and an additional €300 every year after 3 years of tenure

- 
€3,000 per year for co-working space membership and/or internet service at home

- 
€4,000 per year contribution to use for training, workshops, and conferences

- 
€2,400 per year contribution for any equipment or services to improve and/or maintain your physical and mental health

- 
Support for buying tools you need for doing your best work (even eyeglasses if you need a new pair)

title: Lead/ Head of Sales Europe (f/m/d)
description:
At Upvest, we are on a mission to make investing as easy as spending money . Upvest empowers businesses to offer a wide range of investment products and the best experience in the field of capital market investment and retirement planning. Upvest’s Investment API is easy to integrate so that fintechs and financial institutions can save resources and fully focus on their core business.

We are proud to partner with Europe's leading Fintechs and Financial Institutions such as DKB, Revolut, N26, and Raisin. Founded in 2017 by Martin Kassing, Upvest now brings together over 330 talented professionals from more than 70 nationalities. Upvest is backed by €280M in total funding from world-class investors, including Tencent, Sapphire Ventures, Bessemer Venture Partners, BlackRock, Earlybird, Notion Capital, and Motive. Our latest €105M funding round in March 2026 - led by Sapphire and Tencent - serves as a massive catalyst for our growth, allowing us to offer premier investment experiences.

As Upvest enters the next stage of growth, we are looking for an exceptional sales leader for continental Europe. You will work directly with our Director of Growth Alexander Reichhardt owning the topics most critical to Upvest's expansion beyond its current home markets:

About the role: 

Own the go-to-market for Europe's next investment markets 

We aim high at Upvest. Over the last years we have built one of Europe's most relevant B2B fintechs: an Investment API on top of a self-developed core banking engine, with full regulatory licences and investment operations included. Germany and the UK are proven, with more than 20 clients live and over 110 million trades processed in 2025. Our licences are passported across 20+ EEA countries, which means the infrastructure for the rest of Europe is already in place. From here we’re on a journey to enter market by market in Europe, starting with France, Spain, and Italy.

This is your opportunity to turn our foundation into a flywheel for new markets. You will own the go-to-market for continental Europe end-to-end: defining which client segments we go after first, from fast-growing fintechs to established banks, building the target list and the pipeline behind it, and shaping the commercial case that wins against local incumbents and against the instinct of large banks to build it all themselves.

Lead high-stakes sales and win complex deals with financial institutions 

Our clients include the most ambitious fintechs and the most demanding financial institutions in Europe. Winning their business requires enterprise commercial rigour, deep domain knowledge, and genuine client partnership. Deals run over many months, involve procurement, risk, compliance and IT, and are won on substance rather than volume. Since inception we have been delivering on such high touch deals with clearly defined sales journeys, strong materials, and a unique approach now amplified by AI.

You will lead those deals personally before you lead them through others. That means owning the largest opportunities in your region yourself, from first conversation to signature, while bringing the discipline that makes the motion repeatable: rigorous qualification, value-based and consultative selling, predictable forecasting, and a clear view on where not to spend time. You use AI actively to increase your own coverage and later that of your team, and you feed what you learn from clients back into product, solutions, and marketing.

Attract, develop and lead a best-in-class sales team in European fintech 

Building world-class financial infrastructure requires world-class people. At Upvest we put hiring excellence and people development front and centre. The Growth team today features talented, driven people coming from Europe's leading fintechs, financial institutions, and technology companies, with Sales working side by side with revenue ops, marketing, partnerships, and solutions engineering on shared targets.

With inspiring yet pragmatic and hands-on leadership you will build the European sales team around you. You will set the bar for the talent you hire, ramp new Account Executives fast, set and steer their targets, and coach them through cycles that few people have run before. You will be measured on what your team closes as much as on what you close yourself, and you will keep carrying a quota personally for as long as this stage of the business asks for it.

What you’ll do: 

- Real ownership of a region: This is a defining hire for our European expansion. You own commercial success for your markets, with Alexander , our Co-Founder Til Rochow , and the rest of senior leadership as your close sparring partners and supporters.

- A product that gives you an unfair advantage: Our Investment API is genuinely differentiated, a full-stack B2B investment infrastructure crafted with the best product principles and most modern tech stack in the industry. It is live, regulated by BaFin and the FCA, and proven at scale with clients such as DKB, Revolut, N26, and Raisin.

- A team that takes the work seriously: Upvest's Growth team, and the company around it, is one of a kind when it comes to combining impactful work with a collaborative and fun culture. You will have dedicated revenue ops, solutions engineering, marketing, and partnerships colleagues working with you on your deals, and strong practices around feedback, psychological safety, and team health.

- The complexity and richness of financial infrastructure: Working at the intersection of API-first SaaS and regulated financial services, with clients ranging from hypergrowth fintechs to global banks, is one of the most strategic and commercially interesting places to be. Every client relationship and every deal teaches you something new. If you are intellectually curious about how financial markets and products are being rebuilt from the ground up, this is the role for you.

- Flexibility with a European footprint: We are a Berlin- and London-headquartered company with a growing presence across Europe. We are equally open to candidates based in one of Europe's financial hubs, in particular Paris, Madrid, and Milan, who are willing to spend meaningful time in Berlin. What matters most is the quality of your leadership and the results you deliver.

What you bring: 

- 5+ years in senior sales roles, including at least two years leading a team, within high-growth B2B technology and financial services. You have sold API-based enterprise SaaS into fintechs, banks, brokers or wealth managers, and you know financial infrastructure such as core-banking or securities processing.

- A proven track record of closing complex, high-value deals with financial institutions , and of building the foundations that make doing so repeatable. You have taken a sales team from first foundations to early scale, with a proven track-record of exceeding ambitious revenue targets

- Genuine European reach: You have sold across several European countries, with direct experience in at least one of France, Spain or Italy, a strong network in the world of banking and finance

- A modern approach to sales: customer-centric, value-based, data-driven, and AI-enabled. You have strong views on what great looks like, from qualification frameworks to CRM hygiene to how account plans and collaboration roadmaps have the highest impact and are enabled by and enhanced with AI, and you turn those views into standards the team works to.

- Hands-on ownership with strategic foresight: You operate practically, think in second-order effects to get complex deals across the line, and you are genuinely comfortable carrying quota yourself at this stage rather than only managing others who do.

- Outstanding people leadership: You hire exceptional people, develop them continuously, and create a non-hierarchical, inclusive and respectful environment where the best talent chooses to stay and grow. You lead with clarity, empathy, and high standards.

- Fluent English plus native-level in either French, Spanish, or Italian. Investment domain knowledge, experience selling regulated products, and time at a tier-1 growth company are a strong plus.

How we Upvest in you: 

- Best-in-class AI tools: Every Upvenger has €20,000 per year to spend on the best AI tools available — so you're always working with the most powerful models and tooling on the market.

- Impact-driven work: We’re building the infrastructure that will power the future of investing in Europe. It’s complex, ambitious, and meaningful. You’ll work with modern technologies and create something entirely new. No legacy systems, no limits.

- Wellbeing: Recharge with 30 days of annual leave and maintain a healthy lifestyle with sports benefits. Access confidential professional coaching and enjoy the flexibility to work remotely abroad for up to 183 days a year. Recharge with UpRest, a one-month fully paid sabbatical after every 4 years of working at Upvest.

- Development: Growth is in our DNA. Each Upvenger has access to a personal development budget and the freedom to decide how to use it.

- Flexible work environment: Work from any of our hubs in Berlin, London or Tallinn hybrid or remotely across Europe, depending on the role. We give you the choice and budget to work where you’re most comfortable and productive, either at home or in the office. You choose.

- Compensation and equity: We believe that all Upvengers contribute to our success and deserve a competitive, above-market salary and a participation in our employee equity program.

- Team celebrations: Participate in company-wide events, such as UpFest, dinners, offsites and our Holiday party, to connect with colleagues and celebrate our achievements.

- Inclusion : We’re committed to a culture where everyone belongs and thrives. Our Employee Resources Groups foster inclusion and connection, like Upfem for our female Upvengers, or UpVergent supporting neurodivergent Upvengers and allies.

Our Values: 

- Make it easy for others. We simplify the complex and act with the best intentions.

- Own the outcome. We are proactive, fast and confident to get the job done, valuing progress over perfection.

- Rise to the challenge. We aim high and push the boundaries. We stay curious, learn and celebrate our wins together.

- Tell the story. We start with the Why to align on purpose. We are transparent and share knowledge to empower and inspire others.

Upvest is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Software Engineer, AI Coding Tasks (Contract)
description:
Headquarters: Australia 

URL: https://www.askablelabs.com/ 

We're looking for experienced software engineers to build AI coding tasks from a codebase they know well. US$1,000 per task, and you can do as many tasks as you want.

You turn a real change from a repository you know into a task that today's best AI coding models struggle with: hard for the models, but fair for a skilled engineer. Your tasks are used to measure and train AI coding models.

Remote, any location. US$1,000 per task that passes review. Minimum of one task a week, about 10 hours a week.

How it works 

- Apply. Complete a short screener interview and upload your resume.

- Propose. Once you're selected, pick a change from a repository you know and submit a short proposal. We approve it or suggest a better candidate.

- Build. In our platform, set up the repository as it was before the change, then write the brief, the correct solution and the grading checks.

- Stress-test. Try lazy, incorrect and shortcut solutions and make sure your checks catch them.

- Model testing. Run your task against leading AI models until strong models often fail but a skilled engineer can clearly solve it.

- Review. A reviewer checks your task and you revise it. Most tasks take more than one round.

- Next task. Once your task is accepted, start another.

Requirements 

- 2+ years of professional software engineering

- Code merged into a public open-source repository, ideally one you know well. A private codebase you own may also qualify (not employer or client code)

- Strong in at least one of Python, TypeScript, Go, Rust, Java or C++

- Solid with Docker, Linux, Git and automated testing

- Regular use of an AI coding tool

- Experience writing tests, rubrics or evaluation criteria, ideally for AI models

- You can explain a change clearly and concisely, in your own words

- At least 10 hours a week, starting now

- A secure personal or work computer (no public or shared machines)

Nice to have 

- Deep expertise in one area, such as databases, compilers, distributed systems, security or infrastructure

- Experience building agent tasks or RL environments

Terms 

- US$1,000 for each task that passes our quality review, paid directly to you

- Once your proposal is qualified, you sign Askable's contract and accept its terms

- The work is used for AI training. The change and your solution must be your own, and you must be free to license them to us

- Don't publish the work anywhere: no public pull request or public fork

- Proficiency in at least one modern backend language and strong interest in Rust, with either prior Rust experience or clear evidence you can ramp quickly and deliver in a Rust-first, performance-sensitive codebase.

- Some exposure to distributed data or analytics systems (for example, OLAP databases, Kafka- or NATS-style messaging, or change data capture (CDC) pipelines), or strong motivation to develop those skills in this role.

- Practical experience (or strong interest) using AI tools in day-to-day development, along with a thoughtful approach to validating outputs and integrating AI into your workflow.

- Solid fundamentals in system design for your level, including the ability to reason about trade-offs, ask good questions, and align your implementation work with documented architectural decisions.

About the team

The team's scope spans both Grafana Alerting and the SLOs product, so engineers get to work across two products that are deeply connected in how they help users detect and respond to problems.

Grafana Alerting is trusted by major organizations worldwide, monitoring essential medical devices and critical infrastructure. We thrive on collective creativity and diverse perspectives, every team member is encouraged to contribute ideas that shape our product into a dependable tool.

Our domain is quite large, so to get an idea of the kind of work we do, here are some projects we recently worked on:

- Build distributed systems to scale alert ingestion and delivery of Prometheus-based alerts

- Unify Alerting setup and delivery to work the same for Grafana and Prometheus-based alerts

- Build distributed systems to scale alert evaluation of Grafana-managed alerts, reaching over 500 evaluations per second in production.

Grafana Alerting is trusted by major organizations worldwide, monitoring essential medical devices and critical infrastructure. We thrive on collective creativity and diverse perspectives, every team member is encouraged to contribute ideas that shape our product into a dependable tool.

title: Principal Software Engineer
description:
NetDocuments is committed to providing an excellent candidate experience and will never ask you to engage in recruitment activity without phone, video, and in person meetings and communications from emails using the @netdocuments.com domain. If you have any concerns or questions about communications you have received, please send them to  hrgroup@netdocuments.com  so our team members can review.

About NetDocuments 

At NetDocuments, we're shaping the future of legal work. We believe legal professionals should spend less time searching for information and managing documents, and more time solving complex problems, serving clients, and delivering meaningful outcomes. That's why we're building technology that helps organizations work smarter, collaborate more effectively, and unlock the full value of their institutional knowledge.

Our team is redefining what's possible for legal technology. NetDocuments is the trusted intelligent document management platform for legal professionals and the company behind the industry's first and only legal context graph—a breakthrough that gives legal professionals and AI a richer understanding of how matters, documents, people, and knowledge connect across an organization while respecting enterprise-grade security, governance, permissions, and ethical walls.

Innovation is only part of our story. We believe our greatest strength is our people. We foster a collaborative, inclusive, and high-performing culture where curiosity is encouraged, diverse perspectives are valued, and employees are empowered to make a meaningful impact. Whether you're building products, serving customers, or supporting the business, your work helps shape the future of one of the world's most trusted legal technology platforms.

That commitment to our employees and customers has earned us recognition as one of the nation's top workplaces, including:

- Four consecutive appearances on the Inc. 5000 list of America's Fastest-Growing Private Companies

- Five-time Top Workplace USA winner

- Five-time Salt Lake Tribune Top Workplace 

- Multiple Top Workplaces Culture Excellence awards recognizing innovation, employee appreciation, work-life flexibility, and compensation & benefits

If you're excited to solve meaningful challenges, work alongside talented colleagues, and help define the next generation of legal technology, we'd love to meet you.

What You’ll Do 

NetDocuments is seeking a Principal Software Engineer – Intelligent DMS to provide technical leadership across the next generation of our document management platform. This role will help shape the architecture connecting our new web and mobile experiences, design system, extended applications, Microsoft 365 integrations, desktop applications, and AI-powered capabilities into a cohesive platform. You’ll operate as a deeply hands-on technical leader, spending the majority of your time solving complex engineering problems while driving architectural decisions that span multiple teams and products. You’ll partner closely with Product, Design, platform engineering, and our AI teams to establish scalable patterns, simplify complex systems, and ensure the experiences we build meet the reliability, security, performance, and usability standards expected by the world’s leading legal organizations.

You will:

Technical Leadership & Architecture

- Provide technical leadership across the Intelligent DMS organization, establishing architectural direction and engineering standards that span multiple teams and product surfaces.

- Lead architectural decisions across web, mobile, backend services, Microsoft 365 integrations, desktop applications, and AI-powered experiences.

- Define shared technical patterns, component contracts, data models, permission models, and integration approaches that create a cohesive platform.

- Lead complex, cross-team engineering initiatives from early product ideation through architecture, implementation, and production.

- Evaluate architectural trade-offs across scalability, security, performance, usability, maintainability, and speed of delivery.

- Simplify complex systems and establish technical foundations that enable teams to move faster as the platform evolves.

Design & Build

- Contribute directly to the most complex and consequential areas of the Intelligent DMS platform.

- Design and build cloud-native applications, microservices, integrations, and customer-facing experiences at enterprise scale.

- Help architect the next-generation web and mobile applications and the backend services that support them.

- Establish patterns for integrating AI capabilities such as assistants, summarization, extraction, and intelligent search into everyday document workflows.

- Lead technical design for Microsoft 365 experiences, including co-authoring and integrations across Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook.

- Design solutions that maintain correctness, security, and matter-levl permissions across highly concurrent and distributed workflows.

Platform Evolution & Modernization

- Define technical strategies for evolving mature applications and integrations onto the next-generation platform without disrupting critical customer workflows.

- Establish migration patterns that allow legacy and next-generation experiences to operate effectively during platform transitions.

- Drive technical coherence across extended applications, desktop clients, sync, import, browser extensions, mobile applications, and Microsoft 365 integrations.

- Partner with platform and AI engineering teams to establish scalable integration patterns for shared services and capabilities.

- Set performance and reliability standards for customer-facing applications and drive systemic improvements required to meet them.

Cross-Team Technical Leadership

- Lead technical initiatives involving multiple engineering teams without relying on formal reporting authority.

- Build alignment across Engineering, Product, Design, Platform, and AI teams around architectural direction and implementation strategy.

- Translate ambiguous product opportunities into clear technical requirements, architecture, and executable plans.

- Document architectural decisions and ensure teams understand the reasoning, trade-offs, and standards behind them.

- Serve as a technical escalation point when teams encounter complex architectural or engineering challenges.

Engineering Excellence & Mentorship

- Mentor engineers across experience levels, including Senior and Staff Engineers, and provide guidance on architecture, system design, and engineering practices.

- Drive testing, quality, security, and reliability strategies across the Intelligent DMS organization.

- Establish and maintain architecture documentation, engineering standards, and technical patterns that scale beyond individual projects.

- Lead design and code reviews for complex or high-impact initiatives.

- Partner with other Principal Engineers and our Chief Architect to advance technical excellence across the broader engineering organization.

- Support recruiting and interviewing efforts to help build a high-performing engineering team.

Continuous Learning & Innovation

- Stay current with advancements in AI-native product development, distributed systems, cloud architecture, and modern software engineering.

- Evaluate emerging technologies and determine where they can meaningfully improve customer experience or engineering effectiveness.

- Validate new technical approaches with real users and production feedback before scaling them broadly.

- Champion engineering practices that prioritize simplicity, measurable customer value, and sustainable technical foundations.

What You’ll Need to Be Successful 

- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

- 10+ years of professional software engineering experience, with demonstrated experience operating at the Staff level or above.

- Proven experience setting architecture and technical direction across multiple products, systems, or engineering teams.

- Experience leading complex, cross-team technical initiatives without formal authority and driving alignment across engineering stakeholders.

- Deep expertise in system design, distributed systems, cloud applications, microservices, and enterprise-scale integrations.

- Strong full stack engineering experience with the ability to work across frontend and backend systems; our technology stack includes C#, .NET, React, and TypeScript.

- Experience designing and operating cloud-native systems using AWS, Azure, or comparable cloud technologies.

- Experience translating ambiguous product requirements into clear technical architecture and implementation plans.

- Demonstrated experience mentoring senior engineers and providing technical guidance across teams.

- Strong technical writing skills with experience creating architecture documents, design proposals, and technical decision records.

What Will Make You Stand Out 

- Experience shipping AI-native product experiences where AI is fundamental to the product workflow.

- Experience operating multi-tenant enterprise platforms with strict security, compliance, or data residency requirements.

- Experience with Microsoft 365 extensibility, including Office add-ins, Microsoft Graph, or co-authoring technologies.

- Experience modernizing legacy applications while maintaining heavily used production systems and managing complex customer migrations.

- Experience in legal technology, professional-services SaaS, or other regulated enterprise software environments.

- Public examples of technical leadership through conference speaking, technical writing, open-source contributions, or architectural patterns adopted by other teams.

- A track record of leading complex technical initiatives through both successful outcomes and lessons learned from approaches that did not work.

What You’ll Love About NetDocuments 

- The People!

- 90% healthcare premiums company covered

- HSA company contribution

- 401(k) match at 4% with immediate vesting

- Flexible PTO (typically 3 to 4 weeks a year)

- 10 paid holidays

- Monthly contributions for life activities & wellness

- Access to LinkedIn Learning with monthly dedicated time to explore

- Connection, access, and mentorship from exceptional leaders

- Growing company with opportunities for advancement

- Authenticity and accountability from leadership

Compensation Transparency 

The compensation range for this position is $200,000 – $220,000.

The posted cash compensation includes on-target earnings. Some roles may qualify for overtime pay. Individual compensation packages are determined based on factors such as experience, skills, qualifications, and geographic location.

Equal Opportunity 

NetDocuments is an Equal Opportunity Employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind. All employment decisions are based on business needs, job requirements, individual qualifications, without regard to race, color, religion, sex, (including pregnancy), national origin, age, physical and mental disability, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, military and veteran status, or any other status protected by laws or regulations in the locations where we operate. NetDocuments believes diversity and inclusion among our employees is critical to our success, and we are committed to providing a work environment free of discrimination and harassment.

title: Senior Backend Engineer – Energy Optimization & Platform
description:
At Priva Energy, we build software systems that help customers manage and optimize energy in real-world environments, from greenhouses to buildings. You'll join one of our Energy Solutions teams (spanning Building Automation, Horticulture, and Energy Flexibility Trading), landing wherever the need is greatest at the time, and you'll also carry some responsibility for the cloud infrastructure and scalability that benefits teams beyond your own. 

You'll work at the intersection of three things: shipping features end-to-end in Priva Digital Services (touching both backend and, where needed, the front end), integrating optimization and forecasting logic into production services , and strengthening the cloud/DevOps foundation the whole department builds on. You don't need to be equally deep in all three, but you do need to be comfortable moving between them, and you should genuinely enjoy the connective, systems-level work of making things run reliably in production. 

Come Shape the Future of Sustainable Energy with Priva 

Priva Energy is working to become the leading global lifecycle partner for high-performing, sustainable buildings, horticultural operations, and energy distribution and management companies. Energy systems are transforming fast: grid congestion, dynamic pricing, decentralized production, and tightening sustainability regulation are reshaping what our customers need from us. Our Digital Twin and optimization technologies exist to meet that shift at scale, delivering measurable results such as lower energy intensity, greater flexibility and reliability, reduced operating costs, and structurally lower emissions. 

As a Senior Backend Engineer, you'll help turn that ambition into production reality: building the services, integrations, and cloud foundation that put our optimization and forecasting capabilities to work for customers every day. 

Your work will directly contribute to: 

- Reducing and optimizing energy costs and emissions across Europe 

- Enabling customers to participate in future energy flexibility and trading markets 

- Optimizing multi-energy systems (heat, cold, electricity, storage, HVAC) 

- Driving the transition toward autonomous, intelligent buildings and greenhouses 

- Helping customers stay compliant with increasing regulatory pressure (e.g., CSRD) 

What You’ll Do 

Priva Digital Services & product engineering 

- Design and build backend services that process data and execute optimization logic for products across Neo Heat, Neo Light, Neo Building, and Neo Smart 

- Contribute to user-facing Priva Digital Services features end-to-end, including front-end work where it's the fastest path to shipping value 

- Build and maintain APIs for internal and external integration 

Optimization & forecasting integration 

- Implement and integrate optimization and forecasting logic into scalable, production-ready systems. You bring these models into production; you don't develop new optimization theory 

- Work on data processing pipelines, scheduling logic, and system orchestration 

Cloud infrastructure & DevOps 

- Own and improve cloud infrastructure (Azure) that supports scalability across Energy Solutions teams 

- Strengthen CI/CD, monitoring, and deployment practices so systems are reliable, performant, and maintainable in real-world operation 

- Collaborate with product, domain experts, and other engineers across teams to deliver end-to-end solutions 

- Contribute to technical design decisions within your domain, and participate in the full software lifecycle: ideation → design → development → testing → deployment → monitoring 

What you will NOT do 

- This is not a research or modelling role. You implement and integrate optimization and forecasting models rather than developing new theory 

- You are not expected to be a dedicated front-end specialist or a dedicated DevOps specialist. The role spans these areas by design, so depth in every direction isn't the bar 

- A bachelor's degree in an IT-related field 

- Around 5 years of experience in a software engineering role, with demonstrated range across at least two of the following: backend/production systems, cloud infrastructure, front-end, or optimization integration. Versatility across these areas matters more here than deep tenure in a single one 

- You've taken systems into production and kept them running, and can show or talk us through examples (work projects, open source, side projects) 

- Experience with one or more of the following is a significant advantage: Python, Azure, Docker, Kubernetes/CI-CD tooling, SQL, KQL, Linux, and front-end frameworks (e.g., React/TypeScript) 

- You are based in the Netherlands and are available to be in the office two to three days per week 

- Strong problem-solving skills and a willingness to work with complex, unfamiliar systems 

- A passion for creating customer value through high-quality engineering 

- Curiosity, ownership, craftsmanship, and the drive to keep learning 

- Good communication skills, able to explain trade-offs clearly to both engineers and non-technical stakeholders 

- A good vibe: you bring energy to the team and make collaboration genuinely enjoyable, not just effective 

What We Offer You 

💶 Excellent remuneration, competitive and aligned with experience 

🌴 30 days holiday per year, with the option to buy 5 extra at half price  

🏦 Excellent pension contribution  

🎓 €1,000 education budget per year  

⏰ Flexible working hours, and location.  

🍱 On-site canteen (e.g., poke bowl for €2)  

🏋️ Free onsite gym- with personal trainer.  

🎉 A vibrant, open culture where you can be yourself  

🌿 Human- and values-driven work, not corporate bureaucracy  

🍻 Twice-weekly drinks on Thursdays and Fridays

title: Analytics Engineer
description:

Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. - Strong programming proficiency in Python, SQL, Spark, Scala, etc.

- Experience with data modeling, ETL and ELT concepts, and patterns for efficient data governance. Experience with manipulating massive-scale structured and unstructured data.

- Experience with data workflows (such as Airflow), data modeling, front-end or back-end engineering.

- Experience in data analysis and dashboard design.

- Deep understanding of technical and functional designs for relational and MPP Databases.

- Proven track record of cross-functional execution and collaboration. 

- Agentic AI-assisted development experience.

- Excellent communication skills to collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders at all levels of the company, of differing levels of technical acumen.

- Self-starter, ability to work independently and autonomously, as well as part of a team.

About us 

Seccl is the Octopus-owned embedded investment platform, on a mission to help more people invest, and invest well.

We’re building the infrastructure behind the next generation of investing. Our technology already powers some of the UK’s most ambitious fintechs, banks, financial advisers and wealth firms, with close to a million investors relying on Seccl-powered platforms. And we’re now expanding into Europe.

We’ve got a proven product, strong momentum and big ambitions for what comes next: helping more household-name brands launch and scale investment propositions, entering new markets and replacing outdated investment infrastructure with technology that’s faster, simpler and built for scale.

We’re proud to be part of Octopus, one of the UK’s most successful privately held investment and technology groups. That gives us the backing and long-term perspective to build something substantial, while keeping the pace and energy of a high-growth business. Seccl and Octopus are both B Corp certified and share a belief that profit and purpose should go hand in hand.

If you want to help shape the future of investing in the UK and across Europe, you’ll be in good company.

Check out the Seccl website to see what we’re building and read more about our mission to shape the future of investments.

The role 

We're looking for a Platform engineer to shape and evolve the platform that underpins our investment products. You’ll be someone who loves understanding engineering problems and enabling teams to self-serve their needs. You view the cloud platform as a product, and engineering as your customer.

The role is within our Cloud Resilience team - a critical squad within our engineering organisation responsible for empowering squads to build and run their own services. 

We’re primarily in AWS , utilising Lambda, ECS, SQS, EventBridge, API Gateway, Aurora, Redshift among others. Our main data store is MongoDB Atlas and our observability platform is Datadog . Our application is written in Typescript/NodeJS and our infrastructure is defined in Terraform .

On a typical day you will be… 

- Architecting, implementing, and maintaining scalable, secure infrastructure in AWS using Terraform.

- Designing cloud-native solutions using MongoDB, Lambda, API Gateway, and other AWS services with a strong focus on serverless.

- Contributing to incident response efforts, production readiness, and reliability initiatives across engineering squads.

- Enhancing observability and platform insight through actionable alerting and data visibility using Datadog.

- Continuously improving CI/CD processes with GitHub Actions, reducing friction in delivery pipelines.

- Collaborating with software engineers (working in Node.js/TypeScript) to ensure secure, performant, and resilient applications.

- Mentoring engineers and champion DevOps culture and best practices across teams.

This role’s for you if... 

- You’re a pragmatic platform engineer with experience in regulated environments, balancing delivery with compliance and operational excellence.

- You’re confident working with JavaScript/TypeScript-based applications and collaborating closely with development teams.

- You know what “good” looks like for databases like MongoDB and Postgres and can diagnose, design, and optimise for scale and resilience.

- You care deeply about observability - you don’t just monitor systems, you build alerts that engineers can act on.

- You’re fluent in AWS best practices, infrastructure-as-code (Terraform), and CI/CD tooling like GitHub Actions.

- You’ve had exposure to architectural decisions and willingness to own of platform-level outcomes.

This role isn’t for you if... 

- You rely on a lot of top-down direction. Here, you’ll have a lot of freedom and ownership of your role, and you’ll be expected to shape your own progression

- You’re not comfortable working in a fast-paced environment. Our speed and scalability are what set us apart; you need to be able to act quickly and think on your feet

- You struggle to follow through on ideas. We value people who do what they say they will. If you care about something, you have the freedom here to make it happen

- You don’t like change . You’ll get on great here if you relish the ambiguity of rapid growth and are willing to embrace uncertainty

What’s in it for you… 

We offer a generous mix of benefits for the things that really matter to our people, including:

💰 A salary between £55,000 and £75,000 – dependant on experience + reviewed annually

🌴 27 days holiday + bank holidays (some can be flexible) + day off on your birthday + three days (full time) per year for Dependant leave

💙 Two volunteering days per year 

🌎 Option to work abroad for up to six weeks a year

🌟 Secclbrate - our recognition programme that offers a mix of flexible rewards including extra pay, additional holiday and increased learning budget

✅ 6% employer pension contribution, and life assurance

🎁 Perkbox – Flexi-points giving you a range of discounts and perks including free weekly coffee, gym and retail discounts

🚲 Access to initiatives like Cycle to Work and Octopus Electric Vehicle Leasing

Our culture 

We're proud to put people first, creating a culture where we truly listen to what matters most to them. Our transparent and inclusive environment encourages diversity of thought, challenge and experimentation. 

Check out our Glassdoor page for the latest reviews or our LinkedIn for company updates and insights from the team.

Interview process

title: Developer Relations Engineer
description:
About Supabase 

Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth.

About the Role 

We’re looking for a Developer Relations Engineer based in San Francisco to join our team and to help more developers discover, learn, and build with Supabase. You’ll create high-impact content, build real-world projects, and represent Supabase across communities and events. If you’re equally energized by writing code and teaching others, this is the role for you.

Why this role matters

Supabase is growing fast with 350,000+ developers , 1,000+ OSS contributors , and a thriving open source ecosystem. Our users are builders, startup founders, weekend hackers, and engineers scaling to millions of users. DevRel is how we meet them where they are: through content, community, and code.

We’re building a community of communities that brings together developers from many backgrounds, including first-time open source contributors. As a DevRel Engineer, you’ll be a bridge between Supabase and the broader developer ecosystem, helping people get started, go deep, and feel connected.

What you'll do

- 
Make content 

Publish compelling technical content, especially video, to help developers learn Supabase quickly

- 
Build demos and tutorials 

Ship real-world apps using Supabase and tools like Next.js, React, and Stripe. Write guides that others can follow and remix

- 
Represent Supabase 

Speak at meetups, livestream builds, and engage with the developer ecosystem. You’ll be a visible and trusted voice of the platform

- 
Support and grow the community 

Celebrate contributors, answer questions, highlight cool projects, and bring developer feedback to the team

- 
Collaborate across the company 

Work with engineering, product, and growth to amplify launches, prioritize content, and reduce friction for new users

You might be a fit if:

- 
You’ve built full-stack apps and enjoy sharing your knowledge

- 
You create content that makes people want to open their code editor

- 
You’re equally comfortable writing a video script and TypeScript

- 
You’re energized by community whether it’s on Discord, Twitter, YouTube, or in person

- 
You’re self-directed, organized, and excited to contribute to open source

Requirements

This role is based in San Francisco to support regular in-person devrel video shoots, attend local events, and be an active presence in the SF tech ecosystem.

- 
Strong engineering skills, especially with JavaScript or TypeScript, Postgres, and modern frontend frameworks (React, Svelte, Vue, etc.)

- 
Experience creating technical content (written or video)

- 
Comfortable representing a product publicly (on camera, on stage, or online)

Bonus points if you have:

- 
A growing audience on YouTube, Twitch, or Twitter

- 
Prior experience in DevRel or open source

- 
Have used (and loved) Supabase

What We Offer 

- 
Fully Remote 

We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world.

- 
ESOP 

Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together.

- 
Tech Allowance 

Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work.

- 
Health Benefits 

Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us.

- 
Annual Off-Sites 

Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year.

- 
Flexible Work 

We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when.

- 
Professional Development 

Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth.

About the Team 

Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love.

- 
~400 team members

- 
60+ countries

- 
20+ languages spoken

- 
Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F)

- 
540,000+ community members

We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to support—not replace—existing tools and communities.
