title: Deployment Strategist
description:
Headquarters: Remote - India

About the Team 

The FDE (Forward Deployed Engineering) team is a new, strategic initiative sponsored from the CEO and Founders down. Our mission is to win C-suite-sponsored, high-value AI opportunities by selling and delivering outcomes , not just a platform.

You will be part of the founding team, embedded with our most strategic customers from the very first sales call, all the way through to a production-ready solution. You will be the "product manager" for the customer's problem, responsible for the "why" and "what," while our FDEs (Engineers) will be your partners responsible for the "how."

Role Description 

As a Deployment Strategist (DS), you are the critical bridge between a customer's multi-million-dollar business problem and Databricks' technical solution. You are a product manager for the field, owning the technical and product direction of the engagement from initial discovery through production launch and adoption.

You will build C-suite trust, perform deep discovery to map the customer's political and technical landscape, and scope the value. You will define the Minimum Viable Product for a pilot, write the PRD that guides the engineering team, and manage the project to a successful landing. You will also lead technical discovery, shape solution architecture with FDEs, and ensure that each proposed solution can move from prototype to production.

This role requires a rare combination of executive presence, deep product thinking, technical depth, and a hands-on delivery mindset.

The impact you will have 

- C-Suite Scoping & Value Definition: Partner with Sales to perform deep discovery, map the customer's organization, quantify the business value of $10M+ problems, and define the pilot, including its MVP, success criteria, and timeline.

- End-to-End Product Ownership: Author the PRD, prioritize the engineering backlog, manage scope, and act as the primary hands-on QA tester. Translate business requirements into clear data, integration, security, and operational requirements that engineers can build against.

- Technical Solution Leadership & Delivery: Drive the FDE build team through an agile delivery process, manage stakeholders from the C-suite to individual engineers, and unblock technical or organizational issues. Lead technical discovery and design reviews. Understand the customer's data flows, integrations, platform constraints, and operational environment; pressure-test architecture choices; and identify technical risks early.

- Solution Launch & Landing: Own the "Day 0" launch, manage the war room, and drive the solution from launch to full adoption by capturing user feedback, iterating, and proving the defined business value. Own production readiness across data quality, testing, security, performance, and operations. Work with the team to diagnose issues and drive them to resolution.

- Strategic Handoff & Growth: Scope the ongoing maintenance plan, create customer documentation/training, and leverage your trusted advisor status to identify the next high-value FDE engagement. Codify reusable solution patterns and bring field insights back to Product and Engineering.

What we look for 

- Executive Presence & Communication: You are a trusted advisor with strong executive presence and excellent communication skills. You are confident and humble, can build rapport quickly, and can help senior stakeholders make difficult decisions.

- Product Judgment & Delivery: You can define what to build and why, write strong product requirements, prioritize engineering work, manage scope, and lead complex agile software projects from an ambiguous problem to a measurable outcome.

- Technical Fluency & Architecture Judgment: You understand modern data and AI architectures, including cloud platforms, data pipelines, data models, distributed systems, APIs, security and governance, machine learning, and generative AI application patterns. You can lead architecture discussions, evaluate trade-offs, and pressure-test technical decisions.

- Hands-on Technical Ability: You are proficient in at least one language such as Python, Java, or SQL. You can explore data, work in notebooks, read and review code and pipelines, build or adapt prototypes, and contribute meaningfully to troubleshooting.

- Relevant Experience: Typically 7+ years of experience delivering complex, customer-facing data, analytics, AI, or software engagements, or equivalent experience as a founder or technical builder. You have helped deliver data, machine learning, or generative AI systems into production and understand the integration, operational, and adoption challenges that appear in real environments. Experience in a high-growth technology company, forward-deployed organization, or leading consultancy is valuable. You enjoy working onsite with customers (often 25-50%, sometimes higher) to drive delivery.

About Databricks 

Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. To learn more, follow Databricks on LinkedIn , X , YouTube , and Instagram .

Benefits

At Databricks, we strive to provide comprehensive benefits and perks that meet the needs of all of our employees. For specific details on the benefits offered in your region click here .

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion 

At Databricks, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive culture where everyone can excel. We take great care to ensure that our hiring practices are inclusive and meet equal employment opportunity standards. Individuals looking for employment at Databricks are considered without regard to age, color, disability, ethnicity, family or marital status, gender identity or expression, language, national origin, physical and mental ability, political affiliation, race, religion, sexual orientation, socio-economic status, veteran status, and other protected characteristics.

Compliance 

If access to export-controlled technology or source code is required for performance of job duties, it is within Employer's discretion whether to apply for a U.S. government license for such positions, and Employer may decline to proceed with an applicant on this basis alone.

title: Lead AI engineer
description:
About Mirakl: 

Founded in 2012, Mirakl has been at the forefront of marketplace innovation, empowering every business to compete in the platform economy.

Today, Mirakl’s operating system combines an enterprise marketplace solution (Mirakl Platform) that enables retailers and B2B organizations to launch, scale, and operate marketplaces and dropship, AI-powered multichannel selling (Mirakl Connect), retail media (Mirakl Ads) and an agentic commerce infrastructure (Mirakl Nexus).

With dual headquarters in Boston and Paris, Mirakl helps a global ecosystem of 450+ marketplaces (B2C and B2B) and a network of over 100k third-party marketplace sellers. Brands like Macy’s, Decathlon, Carrefour, Asos, and Airbus Helicopters use Mirakl to grow their businesses in new and remarkable ways.

For more information: www.mirakl.com .

Mirakl in Numbers: 

- 🗓️ Founded in 2012 | Member of French Tech Next40

- 👥 750+ employees in 9 offices worldwide: Paris, Barcelona, Bordeaux, Boston, London, Munich, New York, Sydney, Tokyo

- 🇫🇷 350+ Mirakl Tech teams members mainly based in France

- ⚙️ 5 Saas Solutions

Our Values: 

Working at Mirakl means accelerating your career alongside ambitious, passionate, and supportive colleagues. We're proud of the diversity of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences that make our teams unique.

Our 5 values guide how we collaborate:

- 💡 Work Hard Together: Teamwork and collaboration are the foundation of our success

- 🏆 Get Things Done: We prioritize action and efficiency for impactful results

- 🚀 Go Above & Beyond: We tackle challenges proactively and always aim for excellence

- 🎓 Succeed Through Expertise: Knowledge sharing and continuous learning are core to our culture

- 🤝 Satisfy & Empower Clients: We're committed to our clients' success

About the job 

Lead the design, development, and adoption of AI systems within a strategic business domain.

You will combine deep AI engineering expertise with product and business understanding to identify high-impact opportunities, define roadmaps, and deliver measurable outcomes.

As the AI technical lead for your domain, you will drive architecture decisions, engineering excellence, and AI adoption across teams and stakeholders. Examples of domains include: Sales, GTM and Marketing or Finance & Legal

This is a permanent position (CDI) based in Paris or Bordeaux, with 4 days on-site per week.

Annual gross salary range (package): €90,000 – €100,000

This range is provided for transparency purposes and reflects our internal compensation grid for this role level. The final offer will be determined based on your experience, skills, and the scope of responsibilities involved.

Why Now, Why Mirakl 

Generative AI and AI Agents are fundamentally reshaping commerce software and the way our teams work on a day to day basis.

At Mirakl, AI is becoming a core part of our product strategy. From Catalog Transformer and content generation to AI Agents and Agentic Commerce, we are building the next generation of commerce software. And we have the same ambition for our teams around AI products and adoption.

We are looking for a Lead AI Engineer to transform cutting-edge AI technologies into reliable, scalable, and measurable products used by leading enterprises worldwide.

You won't be joining a company that's thinking about AI. You'll be joining one that's already building it.

What You’ll Do 

1. Own Tech Strategy for Your Domain 

- Identify high-value opportunities with Business leaders

- Define the Tech vision and own the agent product roadmap for your domain

2. Lead AI System Development 

- Design and build production-grade AI systems

- Drive architecture decisions

- Ensure scalability, reliability, and maintainability

3. Drive Adoption & Business Impact 

- Work closely with end users

- Measure adoption and outcomes

- Accelerate AI transformation across your domain

4. Establish Technical Excellence 

- Promote best practices for evaluation, testing, guardrails, and observability

- Review designs and mentor engineers

- Raise the quality bar across initiatives

5. Grow AI Capability 

- Mentor AI Engineers and Agent Builders

- Share knowledge and reusable components

- Build AI expertise within your organization

Success Metrics 

- Business impact delivered by AI initiatives

- Adoption within the domain

- Technical quality and reliability

- Team capability growth

Our stack and tools 

- Languages: Python and SQL

- AI Stack: OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Mistral and Open-source models

- Agentic & Retrieval: LangGraph, LangChain, LlamaIndex, MCP and Vector Databases

- Infrastructure: AWS or GCP, Docker and Kubernetes

You'll Love This Job If you have 

- 7+ years in Software Engineering, ML Engineering, or Applied AI

- Strong experience with LLMs, RAG, AI Agents, evaluation, and production systems

- Ability to influence Product and Business decisions

- Proven leadership on complex cross-functional initiatives

Feel free to add a link to your GitHub in your CV so we can understand what you have worked on!

Want to join us? Here is our process 

- A 30-40 min phone conversation with one of our Tech recruiters. This will be an opportunity to discuss your background, expectations, and discover what Mirakl can offer you in return.

- An initial 1 hour technical discussion with a member of the Data Science team and Engineering Team, which will allow you to delve into the more specific aspects of your expertise and discover how your skills can be integrated into our projects.

- 2 x 45-minute "STAR" interviews with future Mirakl colleagues to discuss our values and company culture.

We welcome collaborators with their diverse perspectives and experiences to power us forward. These often far exceed conventional job requirements and help us create a culture of continuous learning. If you’re ready to join a global leader powering digital transformation for 450+ of the world’s most innovative retailers and B2B organizations. 

As part of our recruitment process, Mirakl processes your personal data to review and manage your application and, where appropriate, to consider your profile for future opportunities. You can exercise your data protection rights at any time, and as further detailed in our policies. For more information about how we process your personal data and your rights, please consult our Recruitment Privacy Notice, here in English and here in French. 

We may use Artificial Intelligence (AI) solutions to help streamline our hiring process, including screening applications, analyzing resumes, and assessing responses. While AI helps us work efficiently, all final hiring decisions are made by humans. For more information, visit our AI Guidelines for Candidates and Interviews .

title: Embedded Engineer
description:
Location: Eindhoven, the Netherlands (on-site, High Tech Campus) | Type: Full-time | Level: Medior–Senior, ~5 years of relevant experience

About us 

AIM Solutions is an early-stage deep-tech startup in Eindhoven building inspection and metrology equipment for the semiconductor industry. We are in an active build phase: a small, growing team turning lab setups into a tool that does not exist anywhere else yet.

The role 

As Embedded Engineer you own everything between the instrument hardware and our acquisition software. You integrate cameras, frame grabbers, motion controllers, piezo stages, lasers and FPGA timing hardware, and you make them run as one synchronized, reliable scan. The work is hands-on: vendor SDKs, trigger wiring, PCIe cards and lab networks one day, clean driver code and a live data stream to the user interface the next. You work closely with the System, Mechatronics, Application and Algorithm engineers.

What you will do 

- Design the trigger and acquisition architecture that synchronizes camera exposure, stage motion and laser pulses.

- Integrate industrial cameras and frame grabbers through industry-standard interfaces and vendor SDKs, from driver set-up to stable high-rate acquisition.

- Integrate motion controllers and positioning stages through vendor APIs and controller scripting, including commissioning and tuning with the Mechatronics Engineer.

- Develop and extend FPGA-based timing and I/O for triggering and position-synchronized acquisition.

- Write driver and control layers in C/C++ and Python that the scan and reconstruction software builds on, and expose live status and data streams to the user interface.

- Own the instrument PC and lab network set-up: PCIe hardware, high-speed Ethernet links between devices, IP planning and device discovery.

- Bring up and debug hardware in the lab with oscilloscope, logic analyzer and network captures, and document interfaces and timing budgets with the System Engineer.

- Take part in code review and help move the set-up from prototype to a reproducible, maintainable tool.

Your profile 

- MSc in Electrical Engineering, Embedded Systems, Applied Physics or a related field.

- ~5 years of hands-on experience integrating and controlling hardware, preferably in high-tech equipment, scientific instruments or industrial automation.

- Strong C/C++ and Python, including working with vendor SDKs and drivers on Windows and Linux.

- Proven experience with hardware triggering and synchronization of multiple devices (cameras, motion, lasers, DAQ).

- Experience with FPGA development or working closely with FPGA-based timing hardware.

- Solid grasp of hardware interfaces and networking: Ethernet, USB, serial, PCIe, and multi-device lab networks.

- Comfortable in the lab: reading schematics, using an oscilloscope and logic analyzer, and debugging where hardware and software meet.

- Experience with Git and collaborative code review.

- Full professional proficiency in English.

We value judgment and ownership over a perfect match. If you recognize yourself in most of this, we would like to hear from you.

Bonus 

- Experience with machine-vision cameras, frame grabbers or high-throughput image acquisition.

- Experience with precision motion controllers and encoder-based position triggering.

- High-speed data paths to a host PC, SoC FPGAs or Linux driver development.

- Experience building lightweight web or API layers for instrument control and live data.

- Background in optics, lasers, coherent imaging, semiconductor metrology or lithography equipment.

- Experience with CI, hardware-in-the-loop testing, or working in a Scrum team.

What we offer 

- Ownership of the embedded and timing backbone of a tool that does not exist anywhere else yet.

- A small team with short feedback loops and real impact on the product.

- Hands-on work at the meeting point of hardware, optics and software, on the High Tech Campus Eindhoven.

- A competitive salary for the Dutch market.

title: Softwaretester / QA Engineer als Scrum Master (m/w/d)
description:
Mach aus guten Ideen Software, die im Alltag überzeugt

Du probierst neue Funktionen aus und merkst schnell, wenn etwas nicht rundläuft? Du willst Fehler verstehen, Lösungen mitgestalten und gemeinsam mit einem kleinen Team ein Produkt besser machen? Dann könnte das deine Rolle bei AUGLETICS sein.

Wir entwickeln und produzieren smarte Rudergeräte in Königs Wusterhausen bei Berlin. Bei uns siehst du direkt, wie deine Arbeit das Training unserer Kunden verbessert: Du testest am echten Gerät, arbeitest eng mit der Entwicklung zusammen und begleitest neue Funktionen bis zum Release.

Du ergänzt unser Softwareteam mit vier bis fünf Personen und arbeitest direkt mit unserem CTO Christopher Klabunde. Dein Schwerpunkt ist Softwarequalität. Dazu übernimmst du technische Projektkoordination: Du bringst Ordnung in offene Aufgaben, klärst Anforderungen und hilfst dem Team, Ideen zuverlässig umzusetzen. In diese Verantwortung kannst du hineinwachsen.

Das machst du bei uns

- App und Gerät gründlich testen: Du prüfst neue Funktionen, typische Trainingsabläufe und Grenzfälle und gibst konkretes Feedback zu Funktion und Bedienbarkeit.

- Tests aufbauen und verbessern: Du entwickelst Testfälle, Checklisten und wiederholbare Regressionstests. Schritt für Schritt baust du Testautomatisierung auf – immer dort, wo sie dem Produkt und dem Team hilft.

- Fehler bis zur Lösung verfolgen: Du beschreibst reproduzierbare Schritte, grenzt Ursachen gemeinsam mit der Entwicklung ein und prüfst, ob eine Korrektur auch im Zusammenspiel mit anderen Funktionen funktioniert.

- Projekte ins Ziel bringen: Du strukturierst Aufgaben, formulierst klare Abnahmekriterien, koordinierst Abhängigkeiten und machst Fortschritt und offene Fragen sichtbar.

- Zusammenarbeit erleichtern: Du moderierst agile Abstimmungen, etwa aus Scrum oder Kanban, und hilfst, Hindernisse zu beseitigen. Gemeinsam mit Chris und dem Team entwickelst du Abläufe weiter, die zu uns passen.

- KI praktisch nutzen: Du setzt KI-gestützte Werkzeuge für Testideen, Fehleranalyse, kleine Hilfsprogramme und Automatisierung ein und überprüfst die Ergebnisse sorgfältig.

Deine Rolle als Scrum Master

Du verbindest deine technische Arbeit mit der Verantwortung dafür, dass unsere Projekte gemeinsam vorankommen. Als Scrum Master koordinierst du die Zusammenarbeit im Softwareteam und mit externen Entwicklungsagenturen. Du arbeitest eng mit CTO Christopher Klabunde zusammen; disziplinarische Personalführung gehört nicht zur Rolle.

- Du bringst interne Entwicklung und externe Partner in eine gemeinsame Planung und sorgst für klare Zuständigkeiten, nächste Schritte und nachvollziehbare Abnahmekriterien.

- Du bereitest agile Abstimmungen vor und moderierst sie, zum Beispiel Sprint Planning, kurze tägliche Abstimmungen, Reviews und Retrospektiven – passend zu unseren Projekten.

- Du behältst Abhängigkeiten, Termine und offene Entscheidungen im Blick, sprichst Hindernisse früh an und hilfst dem Team, sie zu lösen.

- Du sorgst dafür, dass Ergebnisse zusammengeführt, gemeinsam getestet und für einen verlässlichen Release vorbereitet werden.

Wenn du bereits Scrum-Master- oder Projektkoordinationserfahrung hast, kannst du sie direkt einbringen. Wenn du neu in der Rolle bist, wachsen wir mit dir hinein: Chris und das Team unterstützen dich dabei. Eine Scrum-Master-Zertifizierung ist ein Plus, aber keine Voraussetzung.

Das bringst du mit

- Interesse an Softwaretests, Qualitätssicherung und technischen Projekten. Erste Erfahrung ist willkommen, aber keine Voraussetzung – auch ein eigener Lernweg oder die Motivation, dich neu in das Thema einzuarbeiten, interessieren uns.

- Freude daran, genau hinzuschauen und Probleme systematisch zu lösen. Du kannst verständlich erklären, was nicht funktioniert und wie es sich nachstellen lässt.

- Technisches Verständnis für das Zusammenspiel von App, Gerät und Backend sowie Lust, dich tiefer einzuarbeiten.

- Eigeninitiative und eine strukturierte Arbeitsweise. Du fragst nach, hältst offene Punkte nach und übernimmst Verantwortung für Ergebnisse.

- Offenheit für KI-unterstützte Entwicklung und Tests. Wenn du damit schon selbst experimentiert hast, zeig uns gern ein Beispiel.

- Gutes Englisch in Wort und Schrift ist erforderlich, um technische Themen im Team sicher zu besprechen und zu dokumentieren. Deutschkenntnisse sind ein großer Vorteil, aber keine Voraussetzung.

- Bereitschaft, regelmäßig vor Ort in Königs Wusterhausen zu arbeiten: Viele Tests finden direkt am Rudergerät statt.

Ein Studium der Informatik oder einer verwandten Fachrichtung, eine passende Ausbildung oder vergleichbare Kenntnisse sind eine gute Grundlage.

Mit Erfahrung oder am Anfang: Wir wollen dich kennenlernen

Du hast schon mehrere Jahre Erfahrung in diesem Bereich? Super – bring deine Ideen und deinen Blick von außen ein. Du stehst noch am Anfang oder hast bisher keine Berufserfahrung in diesem Bereich? Auch das ist in Ordnung. Wenn du für unser Produkt brennst, technische Grundlagen mitbringst und dich schnell in neue Themen einarbeitest, möchten wir dich kennenlernen.

In beiden Fällen ist es unsere Aufgabe, dich gut ins Team zu integrieren und dir Wissen, Werkzeuge und Unterstützung für einen erfolgreichen Start bereitzustellen. Gemeinsam mit Chris und dem Team lernst du unser Produkt und unsere Abläufe kennen. Aufgaben und Verantwortung stimmen wir auf deinen Erfahrungsstand ab und entwickeln sie mit dir weiter.

Zusätzliche Pluspunkte

- Erfahrung mit Android-Entwicklung, zum Beispiel mit Kotlin oder Java.

- Erfahrung mit Firebase als Backend für Apps und dem Zusammenspiel von App, Benutzerkonten und gespeicherten Daten.

- Erfahrung in der iOS-Entwicklung, idealerweise mit Swift oder SwiftUI.

- Erste Kenntnisse in Testautomatisierung, Git, CI/CD oder agiler Projektarbeit. Eine Scrum-Master-Zertifizierung ist nicht erforderlich.

Darauf kannst du dich freuen

- Ein eigenes Produkt, das du anfassen und ausprobieren kannst, und viele Ideen, die wir gemeinsam in hoher Qualität umsetzen wollen.

- Ein Team von rund 25 Mitarbeitenden, kurze Entscheidungswege und direkte Zusammenarbeit mit CTO Christopher Klabunde.

- Raum, fachlich zu wachsen und zunehmend Verantwortung für Qualität, Tests und Projektabläufe zu übernehmen.

- Unbefristete Vollzeitstelle mit 40 Stunden pro Woche und 28 Urlaubstagen im Jahr.

- 50.000 bis 65.000 € brutto pro Jahr, abhängig von deinen relevanten Fähigkeiten und Erfahrungen.

- Arbeitsplatz Zur Heide 10 in Königs Wusterhausen bei Berlin. Ein bis zwei Tage Homeoffice pro Woche sind nach Absprache möglich.

Dein Arbeitsplatz bei Berlin

Unser Standort ist Zur Heide 10 in Königs Wusterhausen. Der Bahnhof Königs Wusterhausen ist mit der S-Bahn S46 und Regionalzügen direkt an Berlin angebunden. Die Strecke vom Bahnhof zu uns lässt sich mit dem Fahrrad zurücklegen. Vor Ort entwickelst und testest du direkt am Produkt; ein bis zwei Tage Homeoffice pro Woche sind nach Absprache möglich.

Einfach bewerben

Schick uns deinen Lebenslauf auf Deutsch oder Englisch. Ein klassisches Anschreiben brauchst du nicht. Ein Beispielprojekt oder ein Testkonzept ist willkommen, aber keine Voraussetzung.

Zum Einstieg lernen wir uns in einem kurzen Onlinegespräch kennen. Danach schauen wir gemeinsam auf deine bisherigen Erfahrungen, deinen Lernweg und die Aufgaben bei AUGLETICS.

English-speaking applicants are welcome. English is required; German is a strong plus. The role focuses on hands-on software testing and quality assurance, with growing responsibility for project coordination. Based in Königs Wusterhausen near Berlin, with one to two home-office days per week by agreement.

title: Software QA Engineer II
description:
Join Axon and be a Force for Good. 

At Axon, we’re on a mission to Protect Life. We’re explorers, pursuing society’s most critical safety and justice issues with our ecosystem of devices and cloud software. Like our products, we work better together. We connect with candor and care, seeking out diverse perspectives from our customers, communities and each other.

Life at Axon is fast-paced, challenging and meaningful. Here, you’ll take ownership and drive real change. Constantly grow as you work hard for a mission that matters at a company where you matter.

Your Impact 

Axon’s RF sensors detect and locate drones so public safety and critical infrastructure teams can protect airspace. You will own the test strategy and independent verification approach for RF sensor capabilities — spanning regression, integration, and real-world validation — so those systems are trustworthy in the lab and in the field. You will work closely with RF Engineering at the intersection of software, hardware, and real-world RF, helping turn technical evidence into confident product decisions.

Work Location: This role is based out of our Kassel, Germany office and follows a hybrid schedule. We rely on in-person collaboration and ask that team members work onsite Tuesdays through Fridays, with the flexibility to work remotely on Mondays, unless there is an approved workplace accommodation. We believe that connection fuels innovation, and our in-office culture is designed to foster meaningful teamwork, mentorship, and shared success.

What You’ll Do 

- Own the test strategy and independent verification approach for RF sensor software from design through release, adding rigor through regression, integration, and real-world validation.

- Design and own test strategies spanning feature, regression, integration / interface, system, and field validation. Combine automated coverage with targeted manual validation based on risk and technical feasibility.

- Develop in-depth functional tests for individual components of the RF sensor software, and keep those tests maintainable as the product evolves.

- Reproduce, isolate, and characterize issues on real sensor hardware and in test environments; capture clear reproduction steps, logs, and environment details.

- Build and maintain hardware-backed automated regression tests and supporting test tooling.

- Monitor and improve development and test systems and test hardware so environments stay stable, observable, and ready for daily use.

- Partner closely with RF Engineering and independently verify behavior in realistic environments and across system interfaces. Execute system, release, field, and acceptance testing with release stakeholders.

- Document test results and defects clearly, and contribute to software design reviews and after-action reviews for the work you own.

- Share knowledge with the wider team, give actionable feedback, and support newer engineers and interns through pairing, reviews, and onboarding.

- Use approved agentic AI tools regularly to design tests, analyze results, and draft documentation and review AI output against quality, security, and performance standards before you rely on it.

What You Bring 

- A degree or vocational qualification in electrical engineering, computer science, embedded systems, or a related field

- 3+ years of experience testing software that runs on or with hardware (embedded products, devices, sensors, or similar systems), including independently owning the test and quality approach for that work.

- Experience with RF, embedded, sensor, or similarly hardware-integrated systems, with the technical aptitude and curiosity to develop deep expertise in RF sensor technologies.

- Hands-on experience building and maintaining automated tests or test tooling, ideally in Python pytest, with the ability to independently support hardware-backed regression testing.

- Comfort working in Linux-based systems (SSH, Networking).

- A collaborative, quality-focused working style: you Join Forces with others, Own It on the quality of the work you take on, and speak up with candor when something is unclear or broken.

- It’s a plus if you have experience with drones or hardware-in-the-loop / continuous integration test setups and an interest in supporting others as they grow.

Don’t meet every single requirement? That's ok. At Axon, we Aim Far. We think big with a long-term view because we want to reinvent the world to be a safer, better place. We are also committed to building diverse teams that reflect the communities we serve.

Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they check every box in the job description. If you’re excited about this role and our mission to Protect Life but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification listed here, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

title: Research Engineer, Content Understanding
description:
Exa is an applied AI lab building a search engine unlike the world has ever seen. We build massive-scale infra to crawl the entire web, train state-of-the-art embedding models to process it, and design super high performant vector databases to retrieve over it. We now power search for Cursor, Cognition, HubSpot, and over 400,000 developers and have raised $350m from Lightspeed, Benchmark, and a16z.

Our ultimate goal is to build perfect search over all the world's information, far beyond Google. If you want to build massive-scale ML systems that will define the way the new AI world consumes information, this is the place for you.

As a backend engineer, you'd play a critical role in our search architecture. We're pretty flexible on what projects people work on based on their skills and interests.

Search quality is bounded by what we understand about a page. Before anything can be retrieved, something has to work out what the page actually says. That means parsing it into the parts that are content and the parts that are furniture, classifying what kind of page it is and what it is about, telling whether the page is usable at all, extracting when it was published, judging how good it is and whether it can be trusted, and working out whether it says anything that a page we already have does not. All of this has to work on every page on the web, in every language, in every shape the web comes in.

Some of this is classic document understanding. Some of it is much more open. Credibility and misinformation, AI-generated and machine-spun content, and pages written to be found rather than read are all unsolved, and search results are only as trustworthy as our answers to them.

We are looking for a research engineer to work on this. There is a lot of room to do it well.

Desired Experience 

- Graduate-level ML experience (Master’s or PhD with at least 2 years of relevant experience), or an exceptionally strong undergrad

- You can build a transformer from scratch in PyTorch, and you have trained models that then had to be cheap enough to run everywhere

- You like building large-scale datasets and living in the data. Most of the wins here are in the supervision rather than the architecture

- You are comfortable with problems where the ground truth does not exist yet and defining it is part of the job

- You care about the problem of finding high quality knowledge and recognize how important this is for the world

Example Projects 

- Make parsing work on the pages where it currently does not, and prove the improvement rather than assert it

- Teach a model to judge page quality, and get everyone to agree on what quality means well enough to supervise it

- Work on credibility and misinformation as a modelling problem: what a page claims, whether it is a reliable source of it, and whether it was written for a reader or for a crawler

- Decide whether two documents are semantically the same or genuinely different, so we can deduplicate the web without collapsing pages that a user would want to see separately

- Build classification and extraction that is accurate at web scale and cheap enough to run on all of it

- Design the supervision for something nobody has labels for, and find out whether it is learnable at all

- Trace a bad search result back to the page-level prediction that caused it, and fix it at the source

title: 3D Computer Vision Research Engineer, Geospatial Visual Localization
description:
About Niantic Spatial 

AI has learned from almost everything online, but it still struggles with the physical world, where 99.5% of economic activity happens. It doesn’t know where things are, how spaces fit together, or what changes over time.

That’s one of the biggest unsolved problems in AI, and it’s the one we’re solving at Niantic Spatial. We build spatial AI models and services so people and machines can reason, learn and act safely in the physical world. We turn camera imagery, video, sensor data and archives into accurate, AI-readable representations of real places that robots can train in and machines can use to know exactly where they are.

In physical AI, mistakes have real consequences. That’s why we build AI grounded in measured reality, not guesswork, so the people and machines relying on it can trust it to get things right.

Our team built some of the world’s most widely used maps. Now we’re building something bigger: a living, measured record of the real world that machines can query, learn from and use to understand how places change over time. If you want to help AI understand the world we actually live in, come build with us.

About the Role 

We are looking for a Research Engineer to help develop our Geospatial Visual Localization technologies, which allows people and robots to accurately localize themselves anywhere on the planet.

This is an end-to-end applied research role. You will develop new approaches to open problems alongside our researchers in 3D vision and machine learning, and publish your work at leading conferences. You will help build and train large models on large-scale multi-modal datasets, including our proprietary collection of 30 billion posed images and ship them into production, to be used by people and robots from all over the world.

Our team works with heterogeneous captures from phones and other handheld devices, 360 cameras, vehicles, and drones, as well as aerial and satellite imagery, LiDAR, and external geographic data. Your focus will be to improve accuracy and robustness across urban and rural locations, cameras, seasons, weather, and capture quality. The system must remain reliable with noisy GPS, in GPS-denied environments, and with outdated reference maps. Each pose estimate comes with an uncertainty that our customers rely on, and keeping it well calibrated across these conditions is part of the work.

What You'll Do 

- Design, implement, and evaluate novel visual localization algorithms, combining 3D vision and deep learning.

- Train large models on multi-modal data at scale, and build the benchmarks that measure their accuracy and robustness.

- Develop robust solutions for difficult real-world conditions: noisy or denied GPS, changing appearance, varying capture quality, large geographic extents, and imperfect reference maps.

- Work side-by-side with leading researchers in visual localization, 3D computer vision, and mapping, as well as engineering and product teams, to identify the highest-impact problems and turn research into end-to-end solutions that operate at production scale.

- Communicate results clearly through technical writing, design reviews, internal presentations, and publications.

What You'll Bring 

- Strong grounding in 3D computer vision, deep learning, robotics, photogrammetry, or a closely related field.

- Demonstrated experience with multi-view geometry and related problems, such as camera pose estimation, monocular depth estimation, SfM, SLAM, georeferencing, point-cloud registration, or sensor fusion.

- Knowledge of transformer models for 3D vision, such as vision foundation models, feed-forward 3D reconstruction, or multi-view and multi-modal attention.

- Knowledge of geospatial data and coordinate reference systems.

- Ability to formulate ambiguous real-world problems, choose appropriate mathematical or learning-based tools, and evaluate solutions rigorously.

- Strong Python skills and experience training deep learning models at scale, with libraries such as PyTorch, NumPy, and SciPy.

- Strong software engineering skills, with the ability to turn research prototypes into reliable, scalable, and maintainable systems.

- Experience taking an algorithm from research idea and experimental prototype through evaluation, benchmarking, and deployment on real-world data.

- Clear written and verbal communication and the ability to collaborate across research and engineering disciplines.

Nice to Have 

- A PhD in computer vision, robotics, machine learning, photogrammetry, geodesy, remote sensing, or a related field, or equivalent research or industry experience. A PhD is not required.

- A strong publication record or substantial active involvement in the research community, especially at venues such as CVPR, ICCV, ECCV, NeurIPS, ICLR, SIGGRAPH, SIGGRAPH Asia, 3DV, ICRA, RSS, or related conferences and journals.

- Experience with aerial or satellite imagery, GNSS/GPS, IMUs, LiDAR data, geodesy, mapping systems, or large-scale spatial data.

- Evidence of technical leadership, mentorship, or successful cross-functional delivery.

Compensation & Benefits 

Base salary: Competitive market rate. Compensation also includes an annual bonus, equity, and a comprehensive benefits package.

title: R&D - Software Engineer
description:
About Us 

QuantWare is building the world’s most powerful quantum processors to solve humanity's greatest challenges. We do this with our unique VIO™ technology, the only QPU architecture that breaks the hardware barriers that have held quantum computing back, unlocking the path to MegaQubit quantum processors.

With VIO, we are paving the way for the hyper-scale quantum computers that will change the world. And delivering on that vision demands people who don’t shy away from tackling the hardest challenges of our time. That’s where you come in! 

We are looking for an R&D Software Engineer to bring production-grade software and data practices into our R&D measurement work. As we scale up VIO, our measurement data, metadata, and codebase are growing fast. You will take our existing measurement software and data practices to the next level, making them robust and maintainable, and building on how we organize data so it supports analysis, yield, and root cause investigations at scale. As channel counts grow, PCMs and test vehicles multiply, and test setups become more varied, you will standardize our experimental workflows so measurement throughput never becomes the bottleneck.

You will also be the link between R&D, the software team in Product, and the data team in Operations, so our efforts stay aligned.

What you’ll be doing 

- Data management: Develop and maintain how R&D measurement data and metadata are stored, linking each device to its related tests, components, and setup history, so cross-device comparisons and yield questions become a quick query.

- Measurement software: Turn measurement prototypes from experimental physicists and RF test engineers into robust, tested, maintainable code, and maintain the R&D measurement codebase for VIO devices, their components, and PCM test vehicles.

- Code architecture & quality: Review, refactor, and maintain modular Python code following modern software practices (automated testing with PyTest, CI/CD, documentation, version control).

- Collaboration: Work day-to-day with experimental physicists, RF test engineers and electrical engineers to improve their measurement code, and connect R&D with the software team in Product to bring in best practices.

- Ownership: Own R&D software functionality through validation, review, and integration.

Your Profile 

- MSc in Computer Science, Electrical/Computer Engineering, or similar, plus 3+ years of industry experience (must).

- Experience building software that interacts with hardware, such as in the context of manufacturing companies, test and measurement systems, lab or factory automation, or control systems (must). 

- Hands-on experience in control of test and measurement equipment is a plus, and experience in a quantum device foundry or test facility is a strong plus.

- Strong Python, with a track record of improving and maintaining code for data acquisition, automation, or scientific pipelines.

- Experience working with databases and cloud computing suites like GCP and AWS for technical or experimental data.

- Working knowledge of best practices, including object-oriented design, Git, code review, and testing frameworks.

- Strong drive to eliminate manual measurement and analysis overhead.

- Comfortable in a multidisciplinary scale-up, translating between experimental hardware teams and production software, and aligning with other teams working on data and software (Ops, Product).

Don't tick every box? Apply anyway! Research shows women often self-select out if they don't meet every requirement. Here's our take: nobody ticks every box. This is a description of our ideal candidate, not a filter. If most resonates and you're keen to learn the gaps, apply. We hire for trajectory, not perfection. 

What We Offer: 

At QuantWare, you’ll be part of a high-performing team of world-class experts in an ambitious, fast-moving environment. From day one, you’ll have the trust, tools, and support to do your best work. Here’s what you can expect:

Competitive salary - A salary that reflects the impact and importance of the role (and of course 8% holiday allowance)

Pension that’s built to last - A generous and future-proof pension plan that includes partner and dependent coverage.

Flexibility built on trust - We focus on outcomes. Work flexibly, in a hybrid setup, with an open vacation policy that lets you manage your time

Personal growth - We invest in your L&D, with a budget available to each team member, dependent on their individual ambitions, development needs, and performance

A connected team - We make space to celebrate wins together, with team events, offsites, and spontaneous moments that bring us closer

Diversity & Inclusion at QuantWare 

We’re an ambitious company, not only for our goals but also to become an even more diverse and inclusive team. We know great candidates don't always follow a straight path, and we value diverse experience, perspectives, and ways of thinking. We know this helps us make better decisions, drives more innovation, and strengthens our culture. 

As part of our recruitment process, candidates may be required to undergo pre-employment screening.

title: Staff Software Engineer, Machine Learning (Consumer Revenue)
description:
Discord has a highly engaged community of millions of daily active users who use the platform for many different reasons, but there’s one thing that nearly everyone does: play video games. Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming, and we are focused on making it easier and more fun for people to hang out before, during, and after playing games.

We're looking to hire a Staff Machine Learning Engineer on our Consumer Revenue ML team. This team applies Machine Learning across Discord's core revenue surfaces — Shop, Nitro, Server Subscriptions, and Gifting — building the ranking, targeting, and recommendation systems that connect users to the right products, subscriptions, and content. If this excites you and you’ve led org-wide initiatives in the past, keep reading! 

What You'll Be Doing 

- 8+ years of experience in applied Machine Learning, inclusive Ph.D. or Master's degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, or a related field.

- Strong expertise in applied deep learning and mainstream RecSys model architecture (e.g. two-tower, transformer-based models, multi-task learning).

- Strong proficiency in Python and ML frameworks such as PyTorch, JAX, or TensorFlow.

- A track record of building ML systems from 0→1 in ambiguous, early-stage environments, and taking them to production at scale.

- Strong product and business intuition, with the ability to translate experiment results into roadmap decisions.

- Excellent communication and collaboration skills — able to lead cross-functional technical initiatives across multiple verticals and keep stakeholders educated and aligned.

- The ability to thrive in ambiguous environments, energized by open-ended, technically challenging problems.

What you should have 

- Built internal ML platform/tooling (shared data standards, targeting endpoints, recommender libraries) adopted by multiple product teams.

- Familiarity with personalized marketing systems — lifecycle targeting, audience segmentation and lookalikes, campaign optimization.

- Deep expertise in distributed training (e.g. PyTorch on GPU, Ray, Anyscale) and large-scale data processing pipelines (e.g. Chronon, Spark, Flink).

This position is US-based and can be remote but if you live in the Bay Area, you're welcome to work from our beautiful SF office. 

The US base salary range for this full-time position is $272,000 to $340,000 + equity + benefits. Our salary ranges are determined by role and level. Within the range, individual pay is determined by additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Please note that the compensation details listed in US role postings reflect the base salary only, and do not include equity, or benefits. 

Why Discord? 

Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming. We're a multiplatform, multigenerational and multiplayer platform that helps people deepen their friendships around games and shared interests, and helps developers build and grow their businesses. We believe games give us a way to have fun with our favorite people, whether listening to music together or grinding in competitive matches for diamond rank. Join us in our mission! Your future is just a click away! 

Discord is committed to inclusion and providing reasonable accommodations during the interview process. We want you to feel set up for success, so if you are in need of reasonable accommodations, please let your recruiter know.

description:
Ditto | Engineering & Product | Remote (US: Atlanta, Austin, SF, Seattle) + APAC | Full-time
https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/ditto https://docs.ditto.live/home/about-ditto I've been obsessed with CRDTs since I first saw them at Strange Loop years ago, and I still can't quite believe I now get to work on them for a living — in some of the most challenging environments there are: disconnected, degraded, contested, out where the cloud isn't. If that's your kind of problem, come build with us. Ditto is the edge-native data platform that keeps distributed systems in sync when the network doesn't cooperate — an offline-first, CRDT-based layer syncing any device (phone, vehicle, sensor, server) over Bluetooth LE, P2P Wi-Fi, LAN, and tactical radio, with or without connectivity. Same core, commercial to defense; operationally deployed and network-agnostic. The problems are the fun kind: conflict-free replication with no server and no synchronized clock, multi-transport routing that never drops the connection, moving a coherent picture over links as thin as an HF radio shot, and human-in-the-loop robotics/autonomy where a detection may have to be physically carried by a moving node. title: Software Development Engineer II (Remote @ Colombia)
description:
Headquarters: Remote @ Colombia

About the role: 

The OfferUp Connect team builds the moments that turn a listing into a sale. Every chat between buyers and sellers, every offer notification, and every saved-search alert runs through services we own, from messaging and notifications to location, meetups, and the subscriptions sellers pay for. We run high-volume Java microservices and streaming pipelines, integrate with partners like Braze, Amazon Pinpoint, Apple, and Google, and use experimentation to decide what ships.

We also take on high-visibility work beyond our domain. Connect built OfferUp's video infrastructure for listing videos and LLM-powered catalog enrichment on Amazon Bedrock, both company priorities that changed what buyers see every day. The roadmap is wide open for someone who wants to help shape it.

As a Software Development Engineer II, you'll own features from concept to rollout: designing and writing well-tested code, launching experiments, and measuring results with Product, Design, and Data partners. You'll raise the quality of the code around you and get the chance to join the next project like video or catalog enrichment.

Here’s more of what you will get to do: 

- Design, build, and deploy backend services and event-driven pipelines for messaging, notifications, location, and subscriptions

- Improve the reliability, latency, and delivery rates of high-volume messaging and notification systems, including retries, rate limiting, and frequency capping

- Integrate with and operate third-party platforms such as Braze, Amazon Pinpoint, Apple and Google push services, and app store billing

- Own features end-to-end: plan, design, develop, deploy, measure, and iterate

- Break down complex engineering problems into achievable tasks and deliver them within committed timeframes

- Work collaboratively with cross-functional teams (Product, Design, Data Science, Marketing, and iOS, Android, and web engineers) to design and implement new features

- Contribute to A/B tests and use experimentation results to decide what ships

- Actively participate in code reviews and enforce good patterns, testing, and edge-case handling

- Coach and mentor junior team members, new hires, and interns

- Create shared components, utilities, and services that improve team velocity across the stack

- Maintain and improve the runbooks, alerting, and monitoring for the features you ship

- Participate in a reasonable on-call rotation with the rest of the team

- Use AI coding tools (Claude Code, Gemini, and similar) to increase your daily development velocity and code quality

- Become a subject matter expert in one or more of the team's sub-domains: messaging, notifications and campaigns, location, or subscriptions and promotions

You’ll thrive in this role if you have: 

- 2+ years of professional software engineering experience

- Demonstrated ability to own the delivery of multiple features end-to-end (plan, design, develop, and deploy) with high efficiency, including breaking down engineering problems into achievable tasks

- Strong coding skills in Java, with a working understanding of microservices and distributed-systems fundamentals

- Good knowledge of data structures and object-oriented design

- Working knowledge of asynchronous, event-driven systems (queues, pub/sub, or streams), including retries and idempotent processing

- Hands-on experience using AI coding tools (Claude Code or similar) in a real engineering workflow, and a point of view on when they help and when they don't

- A habit of following good coding patterns, writing appropriate tests, considering trade-offs, and seeking out edge cases

- Comfortable giving and receiving feedback in code reviews

- A bias toward shipping, learning from production, and iterating quickly

- An insatiable desire and ability to learn

- BS or MS in Computer Science, or equivalent practical experience

Helpful, but not required: 

- Fluency in another modern object-oriented programming language

- Experience with TypeScript and Node.js

- Experience with Agile development

- Experience building and integrating with REST APIs

- Experience with AWS services such as DynamoDB, SQS, SNS, Lambda, and ElastiCache (Redis)

- Experience with notification and engagement platforms (Braze, Amazon Pinpoint, APNs, FCM) or in-app subscription billing (App Store, Google Play)

- Experience with stream processing frameworks such as Apache Flink or Kafka Streams

- Experience with A/B testing platforms (Statsig, LaunchDarkly, Optimizely) and analytics warehouses (BigQuery, Snowflake)

- Experience consuming or integrating LLM-based APIs (e.g., Bedrock, Vertex AI, OpenAI)

- Familiarity with Kubernetes, Helm, and CI/CD pipelines

OfferUp is dedicated to creating the simplest and most trusted way for people to buy, sell, and connect in their local communities. One of the top local marketplace apps for local buyers and sellers in the U.S., OfferUp makes it easy for people to discover more of what they need—from great deals and secondhand goods to jobs, services, home rentals, and more—right in their own communities. title: Prior Labs | Berlin, Freiburg, NYC | ONSITE | Full-time | Technical PM, ML Infra, Research Scientist/Engineer, Backend, Full Stack We build foundation models for tabular data. Deep
description: Prior Labs | Berlin, Freiburg, NYC | ONSITE | Full-time | Technical PM, ML Infra, Research Scientist/Engineer, Backend, Full Stack We build foundation models for tabular data. Deep learning transformed text and images but mostly skipped tables, which are still the data behind most clinical trials, financial models and scientific experiments. The reason is structural: no natural sequence, no spatial structure, no shared vocabulary across datasets, so the architectures and scaling laws behind LLMs don't transfer. Our approach: pre-train a transformer on millions of synthetic datasets sampled from causal-structure priors. The whole dataset goes in as context, predictions come out in one forward pass. No per-dataset training, no hyperparameter tuning, seconds instead of hours. TabPFN v2 was published in Nature and set a new state of the art; TabPFN-3 scales to 10M rows. 4M+ downloads, 8k+ GitHub stars, in production from liquid biopsy to rail maintenance. Code: https://github.com/PriorLabs/TabPFN Since July we're an independent lab inside SAP, with more than EUR 1B committed over four years. Models stay open, research stays public, same team and offices. Roles (most can sit in any of the three offices): - Technical Product Manager, Integrations: take every model release live across SAP (AI Core to SAP Analytics Cloud), the cloud marketplaces and customer environments, and help decide which channels we build next. Reports to me, close to the code. - ML Engineer, Infrastructure: own multi-cluster GPU infra (Slurm on GCP today, multi-provider next), training performance and the tooling layer. We spend tens of millions per year on compute; you own that budget. - Research Scientist, Foundation Model: drive the model agenda - novel architectures, scaling from 10K to 1M+ samples, multimodal and causal directions. PhD plus top-venue publications, or equivalent. - Research Engineer, Foundation Model: same agenda from the engineering side. You design experiments, write the training and eval infra, and co-author the papers. - ML Engineer, Backend: design and scale the backend that serves and finetunes the models. Python/FastAPI, Terraform, K8s. - Full Stack Engineer, ML Platform: build the product end to end. TypeScript + Python, React/FastAPI/Postgres. Also hiring: Applied Scientist, Forward Deployed ML Engineer, Research Scientist (Foundational Data Science), PhD research interns, plus GTM and ops roles. 40+ people with backgrounds from Google, DeepMind, Jane Street, Goldman, G-Research, CERN. title: Staff Software Engineer
description:
Headquarters: Remote

URL: https://www.samsara.com/ 

About the role: 

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) sits at the center of hardware, software, AI, and the physical world. The platform processes 25+ trillion data points annually from IoT sensors, cameras, and connected devices across thousands of organizations, and that dataset is compounding: it grew from 4 trillion to 25+ trillion in four years. We're still early in turning that data into the products that will define how physical operations run, and we're hiring the engineers who will build what comes next.

We're approaching ~$2B ARR growing 30%+ year over year, with 96% of our largest customers on two or more products. The fastest-growing divisions at Samsara are tackling the hardest, most ambiguous problems at the company: building new products from scratch, applying AI and ML to massive real-world datasets, and shipping capabilities that change how organizations maintain equipment, manage fleets, and run day-to-day operations. Most of this work is zero-to-one, at billion-dollar scale.

We're looking for software engineers who want to define what ships next. Leveling is broad and flexible: we're hiring from Senior through Staff+, across platform and product, and we're open to shaping scope around the right person's strengths and interests. That window won't stay open long.

This role is remote and open to candidates residing in the US. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role. 

You should apply if: 

- You want to impact the industries that run our world. The software you build will have real-world stakes: helping keep the lights on, getting food into grocery stores, keeping workers safe. What ships here isn't metrics on a dashboard. It shows up on the loading dock, the job site, and the dispatch floor.

- You want to build, not maintain. Samsara is in full growth mode. We're building new systems from scratch, not babysitting old ones. You'd own entire problem spaces end to end, with the autonomy to set direction from day one.

- You want to work where AI meets the physical world. Samsara has spent a decade building the largest proprietary dataset for physical operations. More connected assets generate more data, more data trains better models, better models drive more value, and more value wins more assets. The market and the opportunity here are what set us apart, not just the models.

- You believe customers are more than a number. Samsara engineers have a rare closeness to end users. You'll participate in customer interviews, collaborate with product managers and customer success, and use that context to build products that solve real problems operators face every day.

- You have the curiosity and drive to figure it out. We're looking for people who take pride in their work and get things done at all costs. The engineers who thrive here don't wait to be told what to build. They define it, ship it, and own the outcome. The rate-limiting step on our teams isn't tooling or process. It's ambition.

In this role, you will: 

- Take ownership of technically complex, mission-critical areas and run with them. We want to point you in a direction and show up to the demo meeting impressed, not spend our weeks managing the details.

- Define and drive technical strategy for new products and platform capabilities, from backend services and APIs to the customer-facing UI.

- Design and ship full-stack features end to end. You'll work across backend, frontend, and potentially mobile to deliver AI-powered products that solve real operational problems.

- Partner with product, design, and customer-facing teams to translate ambiguous, real-world problems into clear technical plans and measurable outcomes.

- Build and scale the systems behind AI-driven products, including data ingestion, APIs, and the workflows that put intelligence into the hands of operators.

- Raise the bar for the engineers around you through code reviews, design reviews, technical mentorship, and by setting a standard for quality, velocity, and craft.

- Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices

Minimum requirements for the role: 

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

- 8+ years of experience in software design and development, including building and operating production systems at scale.

- Strong full-stack fundamentals. You're comfortable working across backend services, APIs, and frontend (web or mobile) to ship complete products.

- Proficiency in modern languages and frameworks (Go, Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, React, or similar).

- Demonstrated experience leading cross-team or cross-org projects from inception through rollout, including managing ambiguity, driving alignment, and delivering measurable impact.

- Experience building AI-powered or data-driven products. You don't need to train models, but you know how to take AI capabilities and turn them into products customers love.

- Strong communication skills and the ability to translate between technical and non-technical stakeholders.

- A track record of building: zero-to-one products, systems you left in a meaningfully better place, or hard problems you refused to let stay unsolved.

An ideal candidate also has: 

- Experience shipping AI-powered features in production, whether that's LLM-based products, agentic workflows, recommendation systems, or other customer-facing AI.

- Comfort with modern AI-augmented development workflows (Cursor, LLMs, etc.) to multiply your output and accelerate delivery.

- Background working with real-world operational data (telematics, sensor data, work orders, inspections) or a strong interest in learning the domain.

- A proven track record of mentoring senior engineers and influencing engineering culture, standards, and best practices beyond a single team.

- Side projects, open-source contributions, or other signals of curiosity and drive outside the scope of your day job.

The range of annual base salary for full-time employees for this position is below. Please note that base pay offered may vary depending on factors including your city of residence, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. This role is also eligible for an initial RSU grant with no vesting cliff, and ongoing refresh opportunities tied to performance, subject to plan terms and conditions. Learn more about our total rewards and benefits below.

Annual Base Salary

$162,400 — $290,000 USD

Total Rewards 

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working 

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara 

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/samsara-staff-software-engineer

About SkinVision 

Skin cancer is highly treatable when caught early, but limited access to specialist care and long wait times delay diagnosis, increasing the risk of late-stage cases and driving up treatment costs. SkinVision, founded in Amsterdam in 2012, exists to close that gap. Our proprietary AI — certified as a Class IIa medical device under EU regulation, with over 90% sensitivity and 89% specificity — has already helped over 3 million people worldwide. Today, SkinVision has a database of more than 6 million skin cancer images and can reach 20 million people through insurer partnerships. Where needed, cases are reviewed by a team of dermatologists, who support users in taking the right next step — from urgent care to a specialist referral. We are extending this further, connecting users faster to the specialist care they need. We're a focused, international team, active globally, united by one goal: making early detection accessible to everyone, everywhere. If you join us, you're not just building a product — you're helping close the gap between a person noticing something and getting the care they need. 

Senior Machine Learning Engineer at SkinVision 

We're on the lookout for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer based in our Amsterdam office with the right skills and experience to ensure the Machine Learning team releases models with exceptional performance making use of state-of-the-art techniques. Not only are ML models vital to our product and hence for our end users, e.g., enabling early detection of skin cancer, they also enable our internal team to perform optimally. The ideal candidate possesses strong expertise in training new and optimizing existing Machine Learning and computer vision models (Python), has hands-on experience in MLOps and deploying models to production (preferably in AWS) and is able to gather requirements and communicate results to the stakeholders directly involved in the model development and deployment. Moreover, in this senior role, it is vital that you can mentor other team members, own the technical processes and actively contribute to the ML roadmap. Knowledge of data orchestration tools (Apache Airflow), data modeling (dbt) and working in a regulated and/or medical environment are a plus! 

What you will do 

- Drive the full ML model development lifecycle: from understanding and co-defining the problem to providing inputs on data collection, assessing the quality of data, model training, validation, deployment and monitoring. 

- Create requirements for data collection for both new and existing models. This includes data for model training and testing. 

- Develop and improve efficient ML training pipelines in the cloud (AWS or similar). 

- Involve stakeholders appropriately during the entire development, deployment and monitoring lifecycle. 

- Scale the ML environment and processes to multiple models being developed and deployed simultaneously.

- Support and mentor team members. 

- Showcase ML models and capabilities both internally and externally, by giving presentations, workshops, training, etc. 

- Stay abreast of the latest industry standards, best practices and emerging trends in Machine Learning and AI and share insights with the broader team. 

Your profile 

- 8-10 years of proven professional experience as a Machine Learning Engineer or similar role, showcasing exceptional proficiency in model training, deployment within a consumer product, data analysis, stakeholder management and teamwork/mentoring. 

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Data Science, Econometrics, Statistics, Computer Science or a related field.

- A vibrant, dynamic, and rapidly growing scale-up in Amsterdam

Founding Engineer

Role can be based remotely in the EEA or hybrid in our London or Munich offices. 

Fixed software is the wrong shape for logistics, because every team runs its processes differently. Tare is our solution. Combining agentic AI with deterministic logic means Tare fits to any customer but runs the same way every single time. We have just closed our pre-seed funding round with a top European VC and we are now looking for a founding engineer to build Tare with us.

About Tarebase 

We're Dom and Felix, the two co-founders of Tarebase. Dom is a former SVP at a global unicorn, overseeing tens of millions in global carrier spend, with deep logistics domain experience from Amazon, Nestle and EY. Felix was a founding engineer at Raycast and has spent more than two decades building software systems. We've raised pre-seed funding from a top-tier European VC and are building our MVP together with early design partners, who will become our first customers. As our first employee, you'd have a real say in both the product and the engineering decisions behind it.

Logistics is difficult to run well, and experienced people are hard to hire. Smaller businesses often pay too much for shipping, struggle to give customers a good delivery experience, and can't match larger competitors' technology or hiring budgets. The software available to them is often expensive, dated or too cumbersome. We want to make logistics less of a burden so these businesses can spend more time selling their products.They're the customers we want to build for: Europe alone has around 26 million SMEs, employing more than 100 million people.

Just putting a chat interface and GPT-wrapper on top of the problem is not what we're building. We're combining extraction and analysis, workflow automation, agentic and compiled AI with deterministic, verifiable logic. Recent advances in AI make more of this possible, but building a system that does it reliably is still hard. We're looking for someone who wants to advance the state of the art in this area with us.

About you 

The description below is an ideal, not a checklist. If you don't tick every box but feel ready for the challenges of being the first engineer at an early-stage startup, we'd still like to hear from you. What matters most to us is that you're motivated, committed, willing to stick with hard problems, and someone we can count on. 

You have a strong technical background and a track record of building and shipping software systems, whether that's cloud backends, web applications, AI-supported systems or a mix of these. You enjoy working across engineering and product. You think like a product engineer: you care about UX/UI, and you want direct contact with customers and the people who use what you build.

You'll work mostly in Rust and TypeScript, across the full stack: data engineering, AI, backend, frontend, infrastructure and deployment. We especially value experience with either language from before AI coding tools and a solid understanding of its ecosystem so you can make considered choices. We also value experience operating distributed systems and data-intensive systems in the cloud, including multi-tenant environments and the scaling and security challenges they bring, databases, and durable execution runtimes.

You use coding agents effectively, but stay close to the code. You know their limitations in a large codebase, review and challenge their work, and take testing, debugging, refactoring and documentation seriously. You can design useful tests and evaluations, manage complexity, and tell when something is genuinely ready to ship.

You also enjoy digging into challenging problems. You keep up with what current models, agent harnesses and research make possible, and you can judge what actually works for a given use case. You know how to build agents and AI workflows into a product and use evaluations, validation and deterministic logic to make what they produce consistent and verifiable. You're comfortable extracting structure from messy documents and care a lot about data quality. You experiment, measure the results, question your assumptions, and keep going until you've found a solution that really holds up.

You can turn that work into shipped software, taking a product idea or technical direction through design and implementation without waiting for someone to assign you a ticket. We work remotely, so clear communication and follow-through matter a lot to us. We value people who manage their own work, can be counted on, and raise important issues early.

How to apply 

Apply with the button on this page. 

Please ensure to use a hand-written CV. We read every application ourselves. It's fine to use tools for spelling or translation, but we want to hear your voice.

Our process 

The process should take a few weeks from start to finish depending on your availability.

- Application review. If we love your resume we will send over some short questions.

- Intro call with Dom and Felix. An informal conversation about the role, the technology and what you're looking for.

- Technical deep dive with Felix. We talk briefly about a system you’ve worked on (no need to share anything confidential), then work through a system design problem together.

- Half a day with us in Munich or London. We cover your travel, hotel if needed, and meals. You spend about two hours on a made-up task similar to the problems we work on, using your usual tools and coding agents. Then we have lunch, go through your work together, and talk through a customer scenario.

- References and offer. We speak with 1-2 people you've worked with (only with your agreement) and aim to decide within 48 hours.

If we don't move forward after the technical conversation or later, we'll share some feedback with you.
